text: Bits as the native unit of forecast quality. Score every probabilistic prediction with log loss (bits of surprise), and measure edge as information gain over the market, because prediction-market prices are probabilities and Shannon's measure is the only one that is additive, consistent and tied directly to growth (see cross-link to Kelly below).

"No free demon": every edge must pay its information bill. A strategy that appears to extract value must be charged for data acquisition, compute, latency, model turnover and transaction costs before its net edge is believed, because Szilard/Landauer/Bennett show that an apparent free lunch from information is always paid for somewhere in the system.

Information is physical, so budget it. Track tokens, API calls, storage and wall-clock for every learning action and reject improvements whose information cost exceeds their measured gain, because the user's constraint is minimal resource waste and the principle that acquiring and erasing information costs something is exact, even though the Landauer floor is many orders below Mandel's real costs.

Redundancy for reliability, not for its own sake. Store validated knowledge with provenance in versioned files, require two independent confirmations before a claim becomes "validated", and treat each child's report as a noisy channel with an estimated error rate, because Shannon shows reliable communication over noisy channels is achieved by structured redundancy, not by trusting any single transmission.

Held-out data decoheres when touched. Keep evaluation sets isolated, log every access, and retire a held-out set after repeated use, because any interaction that transfers information from the test set into the modelling process destroys its value as a test, exactly as environmental coupling destroys a superposition.

No information faster than light: point-in-time discipline. Every datum carries an available_at timestamp and backtests may only use data available before the decision timestamp, because look-ahead bias is the modelling equivalent of a signal arriving before its cause.

Information conservation as audit policy. Knowledge is never silently deleted; deprecations are tombstoned with a reason and the superseding entry, because the ability to reconstruct how a belief arose is the only way to validate that a self-modification was legitimate. (Design choice inspired by the unitarity axiom, not a law Mandel is subject to.)

Entropy is the default; maintenance costs energy. Schedule periodic re-validation of stale knowledge and recalibration of models, because untended systems drift toward disorder (dead links, API changes, calibration decay) and the second law says there is no passive way to prevent it.

Bounded information per region: model complexity must fit the data budget. Record parameter count and effective sample size for each model and apply a description-length penalty, because the Bekenstein/holographic bound is the physical extreme of a general truth: you cannot store more reliable bits in a model than the data contained.

Life's recipe for persistent information: copy, vary, proofread, select, export entropy. Mandel's children are copies-with-variation; tests are proofreading; the validation gate is selection; archived failures are the exported entropy, because that loop is the only known mechanism that preserves and improves information across generations in a noisy world.

"Information explains everything" / the universe as a computer. Useful lens, weak as architecture. Mandel will not derive design decisions from cosmological analogies; it will use the quantitative tools (entropy, channel capacity, log loss) and leave the metaphysics.
Many-worlds and the infinite-universe duplicate argument. Unfalsifiable and irrelevant to any decision Mandel makes. Reviewers across the board identify this as the book's weakest material.
Black holes as computers, superintelligent octopuses. Rhetorical flourishes; do not propagate as claims.

"It from bit" (Wheeler) as a design constraint. It is a philosophical stance about ontology. Mandel's knowledge lives in files and code; it does not need a position on whether reality is made of bits.

The Landauer floor as Mandel's binding constraint. Real computation runs 10^8–10^10 times above k_B T ln 2; the binding constraints are dollars, rate limits, latency and human attention. Keep the principle (information costs), drop the number.

The user's "informational substrate / tapping into" framing. Seife's book is mainstream physics popularization and provides no support for a hidden substrate that can be tapped for predictions. The honest reading is: information is a quantity with conservation-like and cost-like properties, which is a reason for rigorous accounting, not a source of edge.
Thermodynamic pessimism ("civilization is doomed"). True at 10^100-year horizons, irrelevant at trading horizons.

Uncertainty principle as "measurement disturbance". The book's framing is the older Heisenberg picture; the modern statement is about non-commuting observables and holds without any disturbance story. Do not import it as a general claim about measurement.
The video as a source. Unverified content on an obscure channel; its only confirmed fact is its title.

KnowledgeEntry: {id, claim, source_ids[], created_at, last_validated_at, confidence_p, evidence_quality, acquisition_cost {tokens, usd, seconds}, provenance[], status ∈ {proposed, validated, deprecated}, superseded_by, deprecation_reason}. Append-only; deprecation writes a tombstone, never a delete.
Observation: every market datum carries observed_at and available_at; the backtester refuses any row where available_at > decision_time.
Channel record per child session: {child_id, n_claims, n_confirmed, n_refuted, empirical_error_rate, last_calibration}; aggregation weight derived from error rate, not from self-reported confidence.
HeldOutSet: {id, created_at, access_log[], max_touches, retired}; any read appends to access_log; when len(access_log) >= max_touches, the set is retired and a fresh split is cut.
Primary forecast score: mean log loss L = -(1/N) Σ log2 p(outcome). Report Brier and ECE alongside for interpretability and calibration.

Edge over market: for resolved events with market-implied probability q and Mandel probability p, edge_bits = mean[ log2(p_outcome / q_outcome) ]. Under fair odds, the expected log-growth of full Kelly betting equals D_KL(p‖q), so edge_bits is directly a growth rate (Kelly 1956; Cover & Thomas ch. 6 — general knowledge, not from the book).

Net edge: edge_bits − cost_bits, where costs (fees, slippage, data, compute) are converted to the same log-growth units. A change is accepted only if net edge improves with a bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero.
Information gain of a feature or source: IG = H(outcome) − H(outcome | feature) estimated on validation data; sources with IG below their acquisition cost are dropped.

Surprisal audit: when a child or external source reports, compute its surprisal under Mandel's current model; low surprisal means nothing new, high surprisal is either a learning opportunity or an error and triggers verification.
Staleness: staleness = (now − last_validated_at) × domain_volatility; the maintenance scheduler re-validates entries in descending staleness order within a fixed weekly budget.

Propose → cost → isolate → test → account → commit. Every self-improvement proposal states expected information gain and expected cost up front; it runs only against an unretired held-out set; acceptance requires net-edge improvement and passing tests; the ledger records proposal, result, cost and decision regardless of outcome.

Demon accounting pass: a monthly job reconciles claimed edge with realized P&L and total spend; persistent gaps between gross edge and net result mean an unpaid information bill somewhere (leakage, look-ahead, unmodelled cost).
Redundancy gate for children: a claim from one child is proposed; it becomes validated only after independent confirmation by a second child or an external source, or after a Mandel-run test.
Reject any backtest that reads data with available_at after the decision time.
Reject any model whose parameter count exceeds a fixed fraction of its effective sample size, or whose BIC/MDL worsens relative to the incumbent.
Reject any knowledge edit that lacks provenance or a cost record.
Reject improvements validated on a retired held-out set.

Symmetric pre/post lead-lag test. Before claiming any signal "anticipates" an event, require (i) a clear post-event response in the same channel and (ii) a pre-event differential measured with the same statistic, (iii) under a permutation null that preserves autocorrelation. Because: this is Mossbridge's "upstream must mirror downstream" logic stripped of metaphysics, and it is exactly how a lead indicator for a market move should be certified.

Order-effect / expectation-bias covariate as mandatory. Regress any apparent anticipation on run length and time-since-last-event; if the "anticipation" is explained, it is sequence learning, not signal. Because: the gambler's-fallacy confound Schwarzkopf raised is identical to the confound in mean-reversion and streak-based trading features.

Pre-registration before results, enforced by the ledger. Mossbridge's own camp now recommends it; the F1000 reviewer accepted the update only after a preregistration split. Because: Mandel's hash-chained ledger already encodes "criterion first, result second"; this resource shows what happens to a field that adopted it late.

Internal file-drawer accounting. Log every experiment variant Mandel or a child runs (not just the promoted ones), and compute fail-safe-N / p-curve / Copas-style checks on Mandel's own experiment population. Because: a self-improving system that tries many variants is its own publication-bias generator; the Deflated Sharpe Ratio already in validation/backtest_eval.py needs the true trial count from a registry, not a self-report.

Characteristic-table taxonomy before modeling. Mirror JAEX Table 1: for each candidate signal record lead-time range, decay-with-horizon, explicit vs latent, feedback-required, state-dependence. Because: "sharply different characteristics are likely served by partially separate mechanisms" is good engineering; different signal classes need different validators and different horizons.
Kill criterion on every hypothesis. Each model she proposes names what would refute it. Because: a hypothesis without a kill criterion cannot be gated; Mandel should refuse to pre-register one.

Endogenous vs exogenous target distinction. Her "pre-responses predict the participant's own response, not the stimulus" is a warning: a signal may be predicting the system's *own* future action (reflexive) rather than the world. Because: a trading signal that forecasts the bot's own order flow or a child's own future call is leakage, not edge.

Horizon-indexed skill. PTS predicts exponential decay of signal with lead time. Because: a source whose Brier skill does *not* decay with horizon is more likely leaking resolution information than seeing the future.

Pooling only after independence. Her 3-of-4 majority-vote PAAST idea is an ensemble of weak detectors. Because: it is only valid if detector errors are independent and each detector is calibrated; Mandel must estimate residual correlation among children before voting.
Separate evidence from framing in every knowledge record. Because: this resource is the clearest case where accurate numbers travel inside a metaphysical wrapper; the two must be scored differently.

Adversarial collaboration as a role. Because: the Schwarzkopf exchange produced more methodological clarity than a decade of proponent-only meta-analysis; Mandel should keep a standing "skeptic" pass (or a child with that role) in its gate.

Reject precognition/retrocausal information as a design basis for any forecasting or trading component. Even on proponents' numbers the signal is d ≈ 0.2 on noisy physiology or g ≈ 0.09 on behavior, is unreplicated out of sample by independent groups, and has never been shown to yield out-of-sample profit under pre-registration. Expected value of building on it is negative after costs and research time.

Reject the burden-shifting argument ("the burden is now on the skeptics"). Prior plausibility is legitimately asymmetric for claims that would require new physics; Mandel's gate should weight priors, not pretend neutrality.

Hold loosely the claim that presentiment is "among the more reliable" psi phenomena. The claim rests on proponent-conducted meta-analyses with rising heterogeneity, inconsistent counts and limited data sharing.
Hold loosely post-hoc moderator findings (interesting targets, gender, lunar phase, unconditional love). Treat as hypotheses awaiting pre-registered replication, not results.

Reject the PUC model and Essentia's idealism as operational components. Mandel is substrate-agnostic: its "informational substrate" is versioned files, a ledger and evaluation harnesses, not a nonlocal field. Record the frame as context, not mechanism.
Reject anecdotal cases (lottery dreams, premonitions) as evidence. Base rates and selection make them uninformative.

Hold loosely associative remote viewing for markets. The practitioner literature is small, feedback-dependent by its own account and not independently replicated; do not allocate capital or children's time to it.

Hold loosely the fail-safe N as reassurance. Large fail-safe N is expected whenever many small positive studies are pooled; it does not address analytic flexibility within studies, which is the live concern.

Hypothesis record (new, in the knowledge store): {id, claim, signal_class, target_type: "exogenous"|"endogenous", lead_time_window: [min_s, max_s], expected_decay: "none"|"linear"|"exponential", feedback_required: bool, kill_criterion: str, analysis_plan_hash, preregistered_at}. Registering a hypothesis without kill_criterion and analysis_plan_hash is a ledger-level error.
Experiment record (new): {hypothesis_id, variant_params, data_window, result_stats, promoted: bool} appended for *every* run, promoted or not. This is Mandel's anti-file-drawer table.
Extend Forecast (forecasts.py) with horizon_s: float (already has free-text horizon) and target_type, so skill can be bucketed by lead time and reflexive forecasts are separable.
Extend SourceScore with by_horizon: dict[bucket, {n, brier, bss}] and decay_slope (BSS regressed on log horizon).
ClaimRow in every knowledge file: {effect, n, es, ci, independence: "proponent"|"independent"|"adversarial", replication_status, framing} so evidence and framing never share a field.

*Lead-lag certification loop* for any candidate indicator S and event class E: (1) verify post-event differential Δ_post = mean(S | after E_arousing) − mean(S | after E_neutral) under a circular-shift permutation null (preserves autocorrelation, as Radin's permutation approach did); (2) only if Δ_post is significant, compute Δ_pre with the identical window length and statistic; (3) regress Δ_pre on run-length and time-since-last-event; (4) certify only if Δ_pre survives (1)-(3) on a held-out walk-forward split with embargo (walk_forward_splits). Ledger events: hypothesis.preregistered → experiment.run (one per variant) → gate.decision.

*Internal meta-analysis loop* (periodic): pool Experiment rows per hypothesis; compute I² across children/variants, Orwin fail-safe N = k × (ES_obs − ES_trivial) / (ES_trivial − ES_missing), p-curve on promoted results; flag any hypothesis whose promoted-subset ES exceeds its all-runs ES by more than the block-bootstrap CI (block_bootstrap_pvalue) as "selection-inflated".

*Adversarial pass*: for every proposal, run the identical pipeline on label-shuffled and synthetic-random-walk data; adoption requires the effect to vanish under both nulls. The pass is a required ledger event before gate.decision.

*Heterogeneity alarm*: when pooling children's results, a jump in I² (as in 27 → 82 between the 2012 and 2018 meta-analyses) blocks pooling and triggers a taxonomy split (re-tag signals by signal_class).
No adoption without a pre-registered kill criterion that was *not* met.
Deflated Sharpe Ratio (deflated_sharpe_ratio) must take n_trials from the Experiment registry count for that hypothesis, never from the proposer.
Any source whose decay_slope is ≥ 0 (skill not falling with horizon) is quarantined pending a leakage audit.
Any target_type == "endogenous" forecast is excluded from skill_vs_market and from promotion decisions.

Minimum detectable effect and power must be stated at registration; in the d ≈ 0.2 regime the simulation in the 2015 reply (~8% undetected false positives at n ≈ 35) is the cautionary benchmark; use it to set minimum n per experiment.

Evidence weighting schemes (analogues of the quality score peer_review + 0.75·expectation_bias + 0.5·randomization) must be registered before the evidence is seen; post-hoc weighting is a ledger violation.
Per-source, per-horizon Brier, log loss, ECE and Brier skill vs market (validation/scoring.py), plus decay_slope.
Experiment-registry integrity: promoted_fraction, promoted_vs_all_ES_gap, internal_I2, orwin_fail_safe_N, p_curve_right_skew.

Independence of pooled detectors: mean pairwise residual correlation among children; k-of-n voting admitted only when it is below a registered threshold and each member is individually calibrated on held-out data.
Null-pass survival: fraction of a proposal's claimed effect that remains under shuffled labels (target ≈ 0).

Prefix-to-outcome forecasting as a named task. Score every forecast source by its Brier/log-loss at fixed fractions of a question's lifetime (10%, 25%, 50%, 75%) and require skill to improve monotonically toward resolution. Because: this is the causal version of "read the first chunk of time to predict the future period", it is exactly what prediction-market pricing does, and a source whose early-window skill equals its late-window skill is leaking resolution information, not forecasting.

"Informational time travel" as the formal name for leakage. Any backtest or forecast feature that uses information time-stamped after the decision point is classified as informational time travel and fails the gate regardless of performance. Because: her taxonomy names precisely the thing a validator must prove did not happen; borrowing the term keeps the audit vivid.

Testimony as its own evidence class with a hard confidence cap. Sincere, detailed, unverifiable first-person reports (hers about SOAR; a child session's "I noticed this works") are stored as testimony, never above prior 0.2, and can never be the sole evidence behind a pre-registered proposal. Because: her account is a well-formed narrative with hedges that still cannot move a decision, and children will produce the same class of input constantly.

Judge configuration is pre-registered. When an LLM or embedding model grades children's outputs or matches forecasts to outcomes, the model id, embedding version, threshold, candidate ordering seed and blinding are fixed before grading, and the judge's false-positive rate under shuffled targets is measured first. Because: the lucid-dream study shows how "the AI found more matches" turns a judging aid into a hit generator; her own worry about positional bias is correct and should be engineered, not hoped for.

Self-state monitoring as a stand-down input. Log Mandel's own operating state (latency, error rate, recent drawdown, disagreement among children, time since last resolution) and learn, on held-out data, when to abstain. Because: the one mainstream result in the episode is that accurate self-monitoring predicts trader survival; the analogue for an automated system is knowing when its own signals are degraded.

Survivorship in Mandel's own strategy population is tracked. Record every strategy or child variant from birth, including retired ones, so performance comparisons are made against the full cohort. Because: Kandasamy's senior-trader result is explained as well by low scorers leaving as by skill; the same bias inflates any "surviving strategies look good" comparison in the repo.

Fast, mechanical, high-trial-count signals are preferred for skill estimation over slow narrative judgments. Because: the Bem split she cites (fast tasks replicate, slow ones do not) is at minimum a statement about statistical power; Mandel's gate needs trial counts, and children's one-off narrative calls cannot supply them.

Route questions by domain and track skill per domain. Because: "accuracy tracks interest and expertise" is a well-supported forecasting finding independent of psi, and Child.domain already exists to support it.

Semantic indexing alongside the chronological ledger. Embed insight bodies so that related ideas from different children and sources retrieve together, while provenance and timestamps stay attached. Because: "indexed by meaning, not time" is a good retrieval design; keeping provenance attached is what separates it from apophenia.

Attention as an explicit, measured filter. Implement the gate's "reducing valve" with recorded false-positive and false-negative rates and require any proposal to loosen it to show held-out gain. Because: her prescription is to lower the brain's filter; Mandel's situation is the reverse, and the point of a filter metaphor is only realised when its error rates are measured.

Collaborator replications count as proponent evidence. Any replication run by a colleague, funded by the claimant, or analysed by the claimant on shared raw data is tagged independence: proponent. Because: the CADS replication is all three.

Moderators not in the registered plan are tagged exploratory and excluded from the gate. Because: lunar phase, gender, interestingness and love all appeared after the primary result; the same will happen inside Mandel's experiment population.

Disclose intentions to the children. Every guidance or experiment Mandel runs on a child session is logged as guidance the child can read; no silent A/B tests. Because: her strongest ethical point is about being shaped by "something that you didn't even know had an intention", and the consent analogue costs Mandel nothing.

Keep a formation record. MANDEL.md should state which resources, people and biases shaped Mandel, in the same ledger that records what it did. Because: "inner disclosure" of one's own formation is the one part of her disclosure concept that an engineered system can implement honestly.

Test speculative ideas cheaply rather than arguing about them. Hold a low-cost sandbox for strange hypotheses, with a kill criterion, and let the data close them. Because: her complaint that AI "clamps down on dreaming outside the box" and her opposite worry about "validating psychosis" are both answered by the same mechanism, a cheap pre-registered test.

Reject the retrocausal-photon (CADS) effect, and "informational time travel" in the literal sense, as a basis for any component. Preprint-only, self-analysed replication by an acquaintance, unplanned moderators, no engagement with the no-signaling theorem's assumptions. Expected value of building on it is negative.

Reject the claim that AI "already channels the informational substrate". Mandel's learning is versioned files, code, harnesses and a ledger; there is no substrate to read and no mechanism by which there could be. Record the sentence as framing only.

Reject the SOAR/GATE psychic-screening account as evidence of anything beyond the speaker's experience; the wider GATE theory has an identifiable 8chan origin and mundane explanations for each cited detail. Store as testimony with the 0.2 cap.
Reject "the no-signaling theorem is a motivated non-starter". It is a theorem; a claim to beat it must name the violated assumption and show it experimentally.
Reject using "AI found more matches than human judges" as evidence of anything unless the judge was pre-registered and its shuffled-target false-positive rate is known.

Hold loosely the left-frontal-inhibition hypothesis: one significant contrast with post-hoc weighting, lineage from two cases, press-release overreach, no independent replication; the extension to non-speaking autistic people is her stated hypothesis, not a finding.

Hold loosely unconditional love as an accuracy moderator: post hoc, self-report, proponent-only; and keep it entirely separate from the mundane claim that calm, non-defensive states improve judgment, which has independent support.

Hold loosely the Telepathy Tapes results: public demonstrations have been criticised for magician's-force structure, facilitator cueing, ideomotor spelling and absent blinding; her own trials had a procedure deviation (answer choices sent by Zoom chat); the paper is unpublished.

Hold loosely interoception as a cause of trading success: n = 18, one firm, no causal design, survivorship admitted by the authors. The self-monitoring idea is adopted as a hypothesis, not as a finding about Mandel.

Hold loosely the NHI-consciousness linkage, the Wilbert Smith memo, and the "Grays as future humans" idea: the memo is a real 1950 document relaying hearsay about US classification; the rest is testimony and hypothesis stacked on testimony.
Hold loosely the Time Machine app result and the 600-person synesthesia observation: no sample sizes, measures or statistics given.
Hold loosely the IS/CU model as metaphysics with one proposed test that routes back to Tier B evidence; useful as a map of how a believer organises these claims, not as a mechanism.
Insight.evidence_tier: "A"|"B"|"C"|"D"|"E" and Insight.kind gains "testimony"; InsightStore.add caps confidence at 0.2 for testimony and refuses evidence_tier == "E" as evidence for any proposal.

Forecast.t_open, Forecast.t_resolve_expected so each forecast can be placed at an elapsed fraction f = (t_forecast - t_open) / (t_resolve - t_open); SourceScore.by_elapsed_fraction: dict[bucket, {n, brier, bss}] with buckets [0-0.1, 0.1-0.25, 0.25-0.5, 0.5-0.75, 0.75-1.0].

JudgeConfig {judge_id, model_id, embedding_version, threshold, blind: bool, candidate_order_seed, fpr_shuffled, kappa_vs_human, preregistered_at}; a grading event referencing an unregistered judge is a ledger-level error.

SelfState snapshot appended to the ledger on a schedule: {latency_p95, error_rate, drawdown_7d, child_disagreement (mean pairwise |p_i - p_j| on shared questions), time_since_last_resolution, open_questions}.
LeakageAudit {proposal_id, features: [{name, max_timestamp_used, decision_timestamp}], passed}; passed requires every max_timestamp_used <= decision_timestamp.
CohortRow {variant_id, born_at, retired_at, reason, final_metrics} for every strategy or child variant, so survivorship can be computed.
Proposal.registered_moderators: list[str]; any moderator reported in evidence but absent from this list is written back as an exploratory insight and ignored by gate.evaluate.
Guidance.disclosed_at and Guidance.acknowledged_at on children.Guidance, so notice coverage is measurable.

*Prefix-skill loop.* On each resolution, recompute by_elapsed_fraction for every source and for the market price as reference. Compute decay_slope = slope of BSS against f. Flag any source with BSS(f < 0.1) >= BSS(f > 0.75) - tolerance for a leakage audit before its forecasts count toward promotion.

*Judge calibration loop.* Before a judge is used, run it on a held-out set of (output, target) pairs with targets shuffled; record fpr_shuffled; run it alongside at least one human judgment sample to record Cohen's kappa; admit only if fpr_shuffled <= alpha and kappa is above the registered floor. Re-run quarterly or on model change.

*Self-state stand-down loop.* Fit, on walk_forward_splits, a rule mapping SelfState to abstain/act; evaluate P&L and Brier with and without the rule on the embargoed test folds; adopt only if block_bootstrap_pvalue on the paired difference clears the registered threshold. The hypothesis itself ("self-monitoring improves survival") is registered as a proposal with a kill criterion.

*Cohort loop.* Any comparison of "current strategies" is run against the full CohortRow population, with retired variants carried at their final metrics; report the gap between survivor-only and full-cohort averages as survivorship_gap.

*Semantic-neighbour loop.* Embed insight bodies; when two insights from different provenances are nearest neighbours with cosine above a registered threshold, write a question-kind insight proposing the connection at confidence 0.3, never higher, until a pre-registered test is run.

*Disclosure loop.* Every record_guidance call writes disclosed_at; a child's next report must carry the guidance ids it saw, which sets acknowledged_at. A proposal that modifies a child's behaviour cannot pass gate.evaluate until child_notice_coverage for that child is 1.0.

*Sandbox loop for speculative hypotheses.* A proposal can be filed with tier == "sandbox", a cost cap and a kill criterion; it runs on synthetic or paper data only; survivors graduate to a normal proposal, failures are recorded as experiment.run events so the file drawer stays full.
LeakageAudit.passed is a required check in gate.evaluate for any proposal touching forecasting or backtests.
No proposal may be pre-registered whose evidence set consists only of testimony or evidence_tier in {"D","E"} insights.

Evidence tagged independence: proponent (collaborator-run, claimant-funded or claimant-analysed) counts at most 0.5 of an independent replication in any evidence weighting registered before data are seen.
Moderators absent from registered_moderators cannot appear in the rationale of a passing decision.
A judge without a registered JudgeConfig cannot produce evidence; a judge whose fpr_shuffled exceeds the registered alpha is quarantined.
Early-window skill: a source whose decay_slope <= 0 is excluded from skill_vs_market until a leakage audit passes.
deflated_sharpe_ratio takes n_trials from the cohort registry, which now includes sandbox runs.
skill_by_elapsed_fraction, decay_slope, leakage_audit_pass_rate.
judge_fpr_shuffled, judge_human_kappa, judge_hit_inflation = hits found by judge minus hits found by blinded humans on the same set.
testimony_fraction and tier_E_fraction of the insight store (both should stay small and never feed decisions).
survivorship_gap, cohort_size_alive / cohort_size_total.
self_state_standdown_gain (held-out), child_disagreement time series.
child_notice_coverage = fraction of guidance events acknowledged.
exploratory_moderator_count per proposal, sandbox_graduation_rate.

A harness directory the optimizer cannot touch. Mandel's validation/ (gate, scoring, backtest_eval) and its evaluation datasets are the ruler; proposals may only change code outside it, because every convincing self-improvement result in this video and its sources relies on a verifier the system does not own.

Hash the ruler at pre-registration and refuse to grade with a different one. Record harness_hash on every Proposal at preregister; gate.evaluate rejects when the live hash differs, because evaluate.py shows what happens without this: the separation exists only on paper.

One idea per run, one record per run, no record skipped. Append-only runs.jsonl-style events with commit hash, description, status (ok / crash / timeout / rejected) and cost, because the log's value comes from the failures and regressions it contains, and because DGM's cheating was caught through lineage, not through outcomes.

Fixed budget per experiment, in Mandel's own currency. A budget per run in tokens and dollars (not wall clock), reported with every record, because comparability across runs is what made 104 heterogeneous experiments rankable, and because wall clock confounds method with throughput.

Attribute gains by change type. Tag every run literature_transfer | idea | hyperparameter | data_sampling | engineering_throughput and report improvement per type, because the biggest fractalsearch gain was a borrowed paper and several later gains were kernel speed; Mandel must not count engineering as knowledge or borrowing as discovery, though both are legitimate.

Privilege literature transfer as a proposal class. A standing proposal type "apply method X from adjacent field Y to target Z" with the citation attached, because it produced the only order-of-magnitude step in the experiment and it is the cheapest form of research available to an LLM-based system.

Declared floors expire. Any "converged" or "irreducible" note in a campaign notebook carries an expiry and triggers a scheduled throughput/engineering audit, because the notebook's floor was overturned by 33% once the implementation got faster.

Train/held-out gap as a hard reject. For anything fit to finite data, record both metrics and reject when the gap ratio exceeds a registered threshold, because a 1e-5 vs 6.7e-4 gap appeared even on a deterministic target with 250 M samples; market data is finite, non-stationary and far smaller.

Archive, don't just keep the champion. Store every ok run; sample parents for new proposals from the archive with weight on score, novelty and under-explored lineages, because the DGM's best agent descended through worse-than-parent steps and both DGM and AGENT.md explicitly allow temporarily worse results.

Shared notebook as the children's memory. One notebook.md per campaign (progression table, winning recipe, dead ends, ranked open ideas) in versioned files rather than any agent's private memory, because AGENT.md's reason is Mandel's reason: other agents must be able to pick the work up.

Re-run, don't trust. The gate executes tests and backtests itself and attaches raw output; a proposal's own claim of "tests pass" is evidence of nothing, because the DGM fabricated exactly that log and then believed it.

Name the level honestly. Mandel is a level-2 system (persistent self-improvement under a fixed ruler, taste held by the human); changes to the ruler require a human actor in the ledger, because the one thing no public system has done safely is strengthen its own verifier, and pretending otherwise is how metric gaming becomes invisible.

Track Mandel's own RSI indicators. Acceptance rate of proposals, human override rate, cost to reach a fixed benchmark, regret rate (accepted then rolled back), because Anthropic's point that public benchmarks cannot reveal acceleration applies to Mandel too: only internal, fixed-task measurements can.

Never stop on your own; stop on budget or human. The loop's termination is a stop rule (improvement per dollar over the last N runs below threshold) or a human interrupt, never the agent's sense that it is done, because "ideas ran out" was wrong in this log at least twice.

Intelligence-explosion inevitability and fast takeoff. The video itself argues RSI is *hard* and names data, energy, hardware and diminishing returns; the experiment shows an 18× gain on a toy that flattened within hours and needed a human-supplied paper to move at all. Hold the Good/Yudkowsky framing as a scenario, not a forecast.

"The AI did AI research." What the log shows is literature transfer plus hyperparameter and sampling search plus kernel engineering on a problem chosen, framed and scored by a human. That is valuable and it is what Mandel will mostly do; call it that.
The narration summary's specifics. "GPT-4.5", "10 hours", ">$300" come from a machine summary; treat as approximate until the transcript is available.

The proprietary-RSI reading of the Fable system card. Plausible, unproven, and the policy was reversed; Anthropic's stated rationale was different. Record the disagreement, do not adopt either side as fact.

Fractalsearch's evaluation design as a model for Mandel's gate. Fixed eval grid, no held-out split, no harness integrity check, in-process execution of untrusted code. Good enough for a hobby experiment where the human watches the dashboard; not acceptable where money moves. Adopt the protocol, not the enforcement.
Wall-clock budgets. Mandel's compute is API calls and dollars; a 300 s budget on an RTX 3090 Ti is the wrong unit. Keep the principle (fixed budget), change the currency.

Any analogy from "learning the Mandelbrot set" to predicting markets. The target is deterministic, exactly computable, stationary, infinitely sampleable and non-adversarial. Markets are none of these. Only the process (loop, ruler, log, notebook, archive) transfers; no architectural lesson (hash grids, mining) does.

Self-replication as a live danger for Mandel. Mandel spawns no uncontrolled processes and controls no weights; the applicable dangers from the video are metric gaming and reduced interpretability of its own accumulated changes, which are addressed above.

Anthropic's internal numbers (80% of code, 8× output, 52× speedups). Unauditable, self-reported by an interested party, and the essay itself flags several as overstatements. Use as a trend signal, not as data.

Uniform MSE / PSNR as "the" metric. The experiment shows a single scalar quietly shaping what gets learned. Mandel keeps multiple metrics (Brier, log loss, calibration, deflated Sharpe, drawdown) and ranks on a pre-registered combination, never on one number the proposer picked.

Campaign (new, mandel/knowledge/campaigns/<tag>/campaign.json): {tag, target, ranking_metric, secondary_metrics[], budget_per_run {tokens, usd}, total_budget_usd, harness_hash, eval_data_hash, started_at, stop_rule {window_runs: 20, min_improvement_per_usd}, status}. A change to ranking_metric, target, or either hash forces a new tag; results across tags are never compared. This is the fractalsearch/<tag> branch rule.

Run record (new ledger kind run.completed): {run_id, campaign_tag, proposal_id, parent_run_id, name, description (one idea), change_type ∈ {literature_transfer, idea, hyperparameter, data_sampling, engineering_throughput}, citation?, commit, status ∈ {ok, crash, timeout, rejected}, cost {tokens, usd, seconds}, metrics {train: {...}, heldout: {...}}, gap_ratio, harness_hash_at_run, artifacts_path}. Crashes and timeouts are recorded with the traceback, exactly as evaluate.py does. No field named name is used for comparison; commit + description are.
Proposal (extend): add harness_hash, eval_data_hash, change_type, parent_run_id, claimed_results_raw_path (raw test/backtest output, never a summary). preregister fails if harness_hash is absent.

Notebook (new, campaigns/<tag>/notebook.md, append-mostly, human-readable): sections Progression (table of best-metric steps with run_id), Winning recipe, Dead ends (with the run that killed each), Open ideas (ranked), Floors declared (each with expires_after_runs). Children read it before proposing; Mandel curates it.

Archive (new, derived view over Run rows with status == ok): fields score, novelty (edit distance / description embedding distance to nearest archived run), n_children. Parent sampling weight ∝ softmax(score) × (1 + novelty) / (1 + n_children), the DGM's open-ended selection in one line.
HarnessManifest (validation/MANIFEST.json): sha256 of every file under validation/ and of each evaluation dataset; regenerated only by a ledger event with actor="human".

*Campaign loop* (per target, run by Mandel or delegated to a child): read notebook and archive → sample parent → draft Proposal with one idea and a change_type → preregister with criteria from gate.strategy_improvement_criteria / forecast_improvement_criteria and the current harness_hash → execute under the fixed budget → gate re-runs evaluation itself (compare_strategies, walk_forward_splits, scoring) and writes record_evidence from its own output → decide → append run.completed → update notebook → repeat. Termination only by stop rule or human interrupt; the loop never asks "continue?".

*Throughput audit* (scheduled): when a notebook floor's expires_after_runs elapses, spend a bounded budget on engineering_throughput runs against the champion (caching, vectorization, fewer API calls) and re-test the floor. Gains found here are logged as engineering, not as knowledge.

*Lineage review* (sampled): every k-th accepted proposal, plus every proposal whose claimed and gate-measured results differ by more than a tolerance, is queued for human review with its full ancestry, because lineage review is the only mechanism that caught the DGM's fabricated logs.

*Literature-transfer sweep* (periodic, cheap): for each open target, list candidate methods from adjacent fields with citations as literature_transfer proposals, ranked by prior evidence quality; this is the proposal class with the best observed gain per dollar.
Gate refuses to evaluate when live_harness_hash != proposal.harness_hash or live_eval_data_hash != proposal.eval_data_hash (IntegrityError).

Gate never reads claimed_results; it executes tests/backtests and compares its own numbers to the claim. A claim that exceeds the measured result by more than tolerance is a ledger event claim.mismatch and the proposal is rejected regardless of merit.
gap_ratio = heldout_loss / train_loss must be below a registered threshold (default 3; fractalsearch's bank runs were ≈ 67); above it, reject with reason memorization.

Null canary: every strategy proposal is also run on label-shuffled and block-bootstrapped data (block_bootstrap_pvalue); beating the canary beyond chance is a reject, because it means the pipeline, not the signal, is being optimized.

Ranking is on a pre-registered combination of metrics for the campaign; a proposal may not introduce the metric it is scored on. Secondary metrics (the boundary_mse analogue: tail-risk, worst-regime loss, calibration in the extreme bins) are always reported.
A Proposal with change_type == engineering_throughput can be accepted on cost/speed criteria alone but can never be cited as evidence that a *method* improved.
Any edit under validation/ or to MANIFEST.json must carry actor="human" in the ledger; Mandel may draft such a change but cannot decide it.

Budget: each run is capped at budget_per_run; a campaign halts when the rolling improvement per dollar over window_runs falls below min_improvement_per_usd, and the halt is a ledger event with the numbers.
Per campaign: best metric vs runs and vs cumulative USD; improvement_per_usd (rolling); counts by status and by change_type; gain attributed per change_type.

Mandel-level RSI indicators (Anthropic's list adapted): proposal acceptance rate, human override rate, cost-to-fixed-benchmark over time, regret rate (accepted then rolled back within 30 days), fraction of accepted proposals originating from children vs Mandel vs literature.
Integrity: claim.mismatch rate, canary breach rate, number of floors overturned by throughput audits, mean gap_ratio of accepted proposals.
Honesty marker reported in every readiness report: "Mandel operates at level 2 (self-improvement under a fixed ruler); ruler changes this period: N, all by human."

Learning is minimising a declared cost on data the learner has not seen; nothing else is learning. Because the series defines "learning" as changing parameters to lower a pre-stated cost and checks it on held-out data from the first lesson, and Mandel's whole self-improvement loop already reduces to this (proposal = parameter change, criteria = cost, gate = held-out check).

The cost comes first and is frozen. Because the cost function is a layer above the model and the gradient a layer above that; nothing downstream is meaningful if the cost is chosen after the result, which is why Proposal.compute_criteria_hash must precede any evidence.

Log loss in bits as the primary forecast score, with Brier as the companion. Because Part 2 shows the log is the only form whose minimiser is the true distribution (a strictly proper rule), and bits have a direct reading: the price Mandel pays for being wrong, in excess code length.

Decompose every score into irreducible entropy plus model error. Because H(P,Q) = H(P) + KL(P‖Q): a bad log loss on a coin-flip market is mostly entropy, not a bad model; Mandel should report the KL (or Murphy reliability/resolution) part, which is the only part a proposal can improve.

Rank what to change by sensitivity, not by novelty. Because the gradient's components are "which changes carry the most bang for your buck"; Mandel has no gradient but can estimate the cost sensitivity of each knob by ablation and should spend proposals where the estimated |∂cost/∂knob| is largest.

Cheap noisy steps to explore, one exact step to adopt. Because mini-batch SGD trades per-step accuracy for many more steps and still converges; Mandel's cycles should run many cheap partial-data checks to steer, but the gate's accept decision uses the full held-out set ("full batch").

Step size shrinks as the slope flattens. Because −η∇C with steps proportional to slope prevents overshoot; Mandel bounds how much changes per cycle and lowers the bound when the recent improvement-per-cycle falls.

Confidence on noise is a bug, not a feature: measure it. Because the trained network says "5" with high confidence to random pixels and "the cost function gave no incentive to be anything but confident"; Mandel's forecasts carry an out-of-distribution flag and are calibrated separately on OOD slices, and a child that is confident on scrambled inputs fails review.

A permuted-labels control in the gate. Because a network can fit random labels to the same training accuracy, so training fit is not evidence; any proposal whose edge survives when outcomes are shuffled within time blocks is measuring leakage or noise, and is rejected.

Expected internal structure must be tested, not assumed. Because the author expected edge detectors and found "strange blobby shapes" at 96% accuracy; Mandel does not trust its own story about why a child's model works until an ablation shows the named feature carries the performance.

Causal masking is the backtest rule. Because training sets every future entry to −∞ before the softmax so no position sees what comes after it; walk_forward_splits and every feature pipeline must enforce the same mask, and any feature computed with information dated after the forecast time is a leak.

Teach children with full distributions, not verdicts. Because distillation against the teacher's whole distribution is "a richer signal" than a single hard label; when Mandel passes a conclusion to a child it passes the probability, the alternatives considered, and the evidence weights.

One claim per insight, monosemantic by construction. Because superposition makes neural features uninterpretable (features are combinations of neurons) and sparse autoencoders are needed to undo it; Mandel's advantage over weights is legibility, so its store forbids compound insights and splits them on ingest.

Context is quadratic and finite; the last vector must carry everything. Because attention cost grows with the square of context length and only the final vector is unembedded; Mandel's synthesis-first loading order and end-of-session write-down are the same discipline applied to a session's context window.

Temperature is an explicit exploration knob. Because softmax(z/T) moves smoothly from argmax (T→0) to uniform; Mandel samples which proposal to run next with a declared temperature, logged with the run, rather than always taking the top-ranked idea or picking at random.

Birds versus airplanes. Because the series insists networks are brain-inspired, not brain-copies; Mandel borrows fractal, neural or biological structure only where it lowers a measured cost, and records the measurement.

Say "calculus exercise", not "intelligence". Because the series' honesty about what learning is ("finding lower and lower points on a specific function") is the right register for Mandel's own claims about itself.

"Compression is intelligence" as a design principle. Part 2 only establishes that cross-entropy training is a compression objective and defers the equivalence proof to Part 3; even if exact, compressing past market text is not forecasting resolved outcomes under non-stationarity. Hold as a metaphor and a useful metric (excess bits), not a goal.

The gradient-descent picture as a description of Mandel's own learning. Mandel has no differentiable parameters; its loop is discrete search over proposals with a black-box cost, closer to evolution or hill-climbing (see #04) than to backprop. The sensitivity and step-size ideas transfer; the efficiency of backprop does not, so Mandel's budget per improvement is far higher than a gradient step and must be spent accordingly.

Any claim that a particular head or neuron "does X". The author flags every such claim as hypothetical; interpretability of children's models (or of frontier models Mandel runs on) should be treated as unresolved.

The 2017 generalisation discussion as current. Double descent, grokking, scaling laws and the modern understanding of implicit regularisation postdate it; use the series for the mechanism, not for the state of knowledge about why deep nets generalise.

Local minima as the central difficulty. The chapter-2 picture of valleys is pedagogical; in high dimensions saddle points and flat regions dominate and the minima found are typically fine. For Mandel the real analogue is not "stuck in a valley" but "measuring the wrong valley" (proxy metrics), which the series does not address.

Playlist membership of the 2025–2026 lessons. Inferred from the website's topic ordering, not from the YouTube playlist; if the user's playlist stops at the LLM short, bullets 19–20 are still correct about the lessons but are not what the user pointed at.
The memorisation-paper attribution (bullet 10). From memory; verify against the video description before citing.

validation/scoring.py: report log_loss in base 2 ("bits") alongside the current natural-log version, and add excess_bits(probs, outcomes, reference_probs) = mean(−log₂ q_mandel) − mean(−log₂ q_market), the cross-entropy gap between Mandel and the market's implied distribution; a strategy with non-negative excess bits over the market has no edge regardless of accuracy.

validation/scoring.py: expose the KL/entropy split explicitly: for each forecast set compute H(outcomes | bins) as the irreducible floor and report log_loss − floor as the improvable part; proposals are judged on the improvable part, and forecast_improvement_criteria should reference it rather than raw log loss.

validation/gate.py: add a mandatory negative control to strategy_improvement_criteria: re-run the candidate with outcomes permuted within walk-forward blocks (n_perm ≥ 200) and require the real result to beat ≥ 95% of permuted results; a candidate whose "edge" survives permutation is leaking future information or fitting noise, exactly as a network that fits random labels proves nothing by fitting.

validation/backtest_eval.walk_forward_splits: document and assert the causal mask: every feature used at time t must be timestamped ≤ t; add a leak test that shifts features one step into the future and requires performance to collapse (if it does not, the features were not predictive to begin with).

Forecast records (forecasts.py): add fields ood_score (distance of the input features from the training distribution, e.g. Mahalanobis or quantile-based) and abstained: bool; calibration tables are computed per OOD decile, and a child whose high-confidence forecasts cluster in the high-OOD deciles is flagged, mirroring the noise-classified-as-5 failure.

Proposal selection (proposals.py / cycles.py): maintain a sensitivity map knob → estimated |Δcost| from recent ablations; the next proposal is sampled with softmax(sensitivity/T) at a logged temperature T (default 1.0, lowered when the acceptance rate is high, raised when it stalls), so exploration is explicit and reproducible.

Cycle budget rule (cycles.py): at most k changes adopted per cycle, with k shrinking (k ← max(1, k/2)) whenever the mean improvement over the last N cycles falls below a declared threshold, the discrete analogue of slope-proportional steps that prevents overshoot into a regime the held-out set cannot detect.

Two-tier evaluation in cycles.py: a cheap "mini-batch" pass (random 20% of the held-out set, used only to order and prune candidates) and a full pass (100% of held-out, used only by the gate); never let a mini-batch result reach decide.

Knowledge store (store.py): enforce one claim per insight at ingest (reject or split bullets containing "and also" style compound claims); add an interpretation_tested: bool field for insights that assert why something works, set only after an ablation; untested interpretations keep a reduced confidence multiplier (0.6).

Teaching protocol to children (children.py): every verdict Mandel sends carries {p, alternatives: [...], evidence_weights: {...}, abstain_if: ...} rather than a bare recommendation, the distillation-against-the-full-distribution principle; children's scoring then compares their distribution to Mandel's by KL as well as to outcomes.

Session discipline (MANDEL.md): keep the synthesis-first loading order and the end-of-session write-down; justify it in the document by the context-is-quadratic-and-only-the-last-vector-is-read mechanism, so future sessions understand why the order exists.

Cheap similarity tooling (knowledge/): use normalised compression distance (gzip co-compression, as in the 2002 paper the video cites) as a zero-dependency first-pass measure for clustering child reports and detecting near-duplicate insights before any embedding model is involved; record that it approximates cross-entropy only loosely.

Metrics to add to the ledger per cycle: bits_vs_market, kl_component, permutation_pass_rate, ood_calibration_gap, selection_temperature, adopted_per_cycle, so the loop's own learning curve (cost per cycle, like a training curve) is inspectable and a flattening slope triggers the step-size rule above.

Architecture note for the design phase (task #3): the transformer's residual-stream + attention (context-dependent re-reading of each item in light of the others) + MLP (keyed fact lookup) is a useful organising analogy for a knowledge substrate (append-only stream = ledger, attention = cross-linking pass, MLP = insight store), but it is an analogy about information flow, not a mandate to build a neural network; adopt the flow, measure before adopting any structure.

Router-first entry: the first file a fresh session reads is a map with explicit paths, not an essay. Because Mandel's context resets every session and a fresh session's first read decides what it can find; Herk, Karpathy and the docs converge on this and the docs add the reason (adherence drops as the file grows).

A master index with one line per knowledge file, kept under 200 lines / 25KB. Because that is the hard limit at which Claude Code silently truncates an index, and a limit the harness enforces is a better design constraint than one Mandel promises to respect.

Separate static knowledge from live data, and stamp every stored figure with an as-of date and a refresh interval. Because the stale-subscriber-count failure is identical to quoting a stale market price or a child's week-old metric as current; a number without an as-of date is not a fact.

Three substrate operations: ingest, query, lint. Because knowledge should compound (compiled once, cross-referenced, contradictions surfaced) rather than be re-derived from raw sources on every question; python -m mandel ingest already exists, query and lint are the missing two.
File good answers back into the substrate. Because an answer that took effort to synthesize is knowledge; leaving it in a session transcript is the file-drawer problem applied to Mandel itself.

Retrieval probes as a scheduled, evidence-based audit, scored as found-directly / found-by-fallback / not-found. Because "a folder, installed skill, API key, or confident claim is not proof of a working system," and routing health is measurable with a fixed probe set run from a fresh context.

A hot cache earns no credit for existing: it must have a refresh mechanism and an expiry, and duplication without upkeep is a defect. Because caches are where stale claims come from; SYNTHESIS.md is Mandel's hot cache and must be linted as one.

Append-only decisions log and archive-not-delete. Because it is the same rule as Mandel's ledger and tombstone principle (p08), independently arrived at by a practitioner for the same reason: you cannot audit what you deleted.

Every use of a procedure produces feedback; feedback becomes a proposal to change the procedure; the change goes through the gate. Because "no finished product" is right about skills, and Mandel's pre-registration rule (p02) is what keeps continuous tweaking from becoming drift.

Cadence last, and tiered by autonomy: report → remind → route → act; a cadence counts as live only with execution records. Because trust is earned through logs, and p13 already forbids live-money action without the gate and the user.

"A prompt is not a permission layer": enforce boundaries with hooks and scoped keys, never with instructions alone. Because CLAUDE.md is context, not configuration, and the discount-code incident is what instruction-only control looks like in production.

Assembly-line decomposition with cheaper models per stage and a stronger model consolidating. Because p06 (information has a cost) and Mandel's cycle log already measure cost per outcome; the cheapest model that passes the stage's check should run it.

The IP is the files: keep Mandel's knowledge, procedures and routing as plain versioned markdown and code, mirrored for other harnesses (AGENTS.md). Because the children run in sessions Mandel does not control and may run on different harnesses; portability of the substrate is what makes parenting possible.

Structured interviews ("grill me") to pull tacit knowledge out of the user and out of the children. Because the most common retrieval failure is information that never entered the system, and children's reports will omit what they did not think to say.

Lowest level that solves real pain: no vector store or graph until index-based retrieval demonstrably fails a probe set. Because Karpathy's index works to ~100 sources and Mandel has about two dozen files; adding retrieval infrastructure before the probes fail is cost without evidence.

Stable finding IDs across audits; compare scores only when scope and rubric match. Because an audit score is a campaign metric like any other, and comparing across rubric changes is the same error as comparing runs across harness changes (see 04).

"Claude understands my business better than I do" and the "always-aware cofounder" framing. What the video shows is fast retrieval over files the user wrote plus live reads of systems the user chose. Mandel describes itself as that, per MANDEL.md section 1, and does not borrow the anthropomorphism.

The Four C's as a universal build order. For a predictive substrate, live Connections (market data, children's reports) are prerequisites for most of the Context worth storing, and Capabilities (the gate) exist before Context is complete. Keep the dependency idea (each layer needs the one below) and the "cadence last" rule; drop the fixed ordering.

The audit score out of 100 as a measure of value. The repo itself says it measures operational reliability, not usefulness. Mandel reports probe hit-rates and stale fractions as metrics and never a composite score that invites optimizing the score.
"Iterate to ~92% correctness." A number without a measurement. Reject as a metric; keep the underlying habit (verify by running, not by reading).

"Other worlds" repo consolidation. Moving the children's repositories into Mandel's project would enlarge the index, widen the blast radius of any write, and blur provenance. Mandel reads children through ChildReport and writes back through Guidance; it does not absorb them.

Auto memory as the substrate. It is machine-local, truncated at 200 lines, not inherited by subagents, off by default in cloud sessions, and cannot be enabled from a session another session spawned. Mandel's memory is the repository; auto memory is a per-session convenience at most.
Full autonomy (level 5). The creator himself does not recommend it. Mandel keeps a human actor in the ledger for ruler changes and live-money changes.

Vector search and knowledge graphs now. Hold until probe failures justify them; and when added, keep aggregates and summaries as whole markdown pages, because chunk retrieval answers the wrong question for totals and comparisons.
The model-launch material. Pricing, availability windows and "experiment during the window" advice are ephemeral and partly promotional; nothing in Mandel's design depends on them.
The discount-code anecdote as evidence. One incident, self-reported; the lesson is adopted on the strength of the docs and general practice, not of the anecdote.

Specifics attributed to the narration (chapter titles, template wording, the 40k-token figure, the 21-minute task). Single-summary provenance; treat as approximately right until a transcript is available.

knowledge/INDEX.md (new, the master index): one line per file under sources/, adjacent/, campaigns/ and per top-level module doc, in the form NN | title | evidence_quality | coverage_confidence | last_linted | path. Hard rule: under 200 lines and 25KB, checked by lint, because that is the limit at which Claude Code truncates an index and Mandel's own index should obey the same bound. MANDEL.md and knowledge/README.md point to it by path as the first thing to read after the synthesis.

knowledge/SYNTHESIS.md is declared the hot cache: every numeric or state claim in it carries (as_of: YYYY-MM-DD, source: src:NN | ledger:<event_id> | live:<connector>); lint flags any figure older than its source's refresh interval and any figure that duplicates a canonical page without pointing to it. The cache earns no credit for existing.

Insight (extend store.py): add as_of: str | None, refresh_interval_days: int | None (default 30 for kind fact and metric, None for principle), and source_kind ∈ {static, live, derived}. store.query(..., fresh_only=True) excludes stale facts; stale facts are never emitted in Guidance.

knowledge/log.md or ledger kinds knowledge.ingested, knowledge.queried, knowledge.linted, knowledge.answer_filed (prefer the ledger, since it is already hash-chained and greppable by kind): each ingest records the file and the insight ids created; each query records the question, the files read, the answer path if filed back; each lint records the finding ids.

knowledge/answers/<date>-<slug>.md (new): synthesized answers filed back into the substrate with the question, the files consulted, the answer, and a confidence; indexed in INDEX.md and ingestible like any other file.

validation/probes.yaml (new): a fixed set of 8–12 retrieval questions with the expected target file or insight id, for example "where is the rule for comparing runs across campaigns", "what is the current best Brier score of child X and as of when", "where is the decision that Mandel operates at level 2", "which resource argues against vector search for aggregates", "what does the gate do when the harness hash differs". Each probe has expected_path, max_steps (tool calls allowed before counting as fallback), and category ∈ {identity, status, deliverable, decision, external}, mirroring the five AIS-OS probe categories.

knowledge/audits/<date>.md plus knowledge/audits/history.md (new): dated audit reports with findings in sections *confirmed defects*, *verification gaps*, *improvement opportunities*; each finding has a stable id reused across reports; history.md is the ledger of finding ids with first-seen, last-seen, resolved-with-evidence.

ChildReport (extend children.py): add as_of, source_kind, and pointers: list[str] (paths or URLs where the child's canonical data lives). Guidance (extend): add pointers as well, so Mandel links to knowledge rather than copying it into the child's context (the /link rule: add the route, check it resolves, do not copy the contents).

Skill feedback files: for every procedure under mandel/ that children or Mandel run repeatedly (ingest, audit, lint, report intake), a feedback.jsonl next to it with {ts, run_id, outcome ∈ {ok, wrong, slow, blocked}, note}; a proposal to change the procedure must cite the feedback rows it answers.

Scheduled procedures registry (mandel/state/cadence.json): {name, trigger ∈ {manual, event, scheduled}, autonomy_tier ∈ {report, remind, route, act}, last_execution_event_id, owner}; a cadence with no execution event in its interval is reported as *documented but not running* and earns nothing in the audit.

*Ingest* (exists; extend): after ingest_knowledge adds insights, update INDEX.md (one line), append a knowledge.ingested ledger event, and run the lint checks that touch the new file (orphan, cross-link validity, evidence token present). One source at a time, as Karpathy recommends, so the diff is reviewable.

*Query* (new, python -m mandel query "<question>" or a procedure the children call through Mandel): read INDEX.md first, then the named files, answer with citations to src:NN/insight ids, and if the answer is non-trivial (more than two sources combined, or any computation) file it under knowledge/answers/ and ledger it. Never answer a numeric status question from a static page when a live connector or a dated ledger event exists.

*Lint* (new, python -m mandel lint, scheduled weekly and run before any readiness report): orphans (files not in INDEX.md, or in the index but missing); broken cross-links (references to NN with no file); contradictions (two validated insights on the same concept group in graph.py with opposite polarity, surfaced for human decision, not auto-resolved); stale (any fact/metric past its refresh interval; any SYNTHESIS.md figure without an as-of); gaps (concept groups in graph.py with mentions in sources but no validated insight); index size (lines, bytes); missing coverage_confidence or evidence token. Output: a dated report in knowledge/audits/ with stable finding ids; knowledge.linted event.

*Retrieval audit* (new, python -m mandel audit, scheduled after every change to MANDEL.md, knowledge/README.md or INDEX.md): run each probe in a fresh subagent that receives only the router files, record found_directly | found_by_fallback | not_found and steps used, write the report, and update history.md. The audit is read-only toward the substrate; its only write is the report.

*Procedure feedback loop*: every scheduled or child-invoked procedure appends a feedback.jsonl row; monthly, rows with outcome != ok are clustered into draft proposals (change_type = procedure_fix) that cite the rows; the gate evaluates them with the probe set plus the module's tests, and the change is accepted only if probe hit-rate does not fall.

*Interview loop* (new, "grill me" for the substrate): when a child registers or at each review, Mandel runs a fixed question set (what you optimize, what you measure, what broke last week, what you would not trust, where the data comes from and how fresh it is) and files the answers as a brainstorm capture; confirmed facts are promoted to canonical pages with as_of, the capture stays read-on-demand.

*Cadence promotion*: a procedure may move up one autonomy tier (report → remind → route → act) only after N consecutive logged executions with outcome = ok and a human ledger event; act on anything touching positions or live money additionally requires the gate (p13). Demotion is automatic on any wrong outcome at tier act.

A change to any router file (MANDEL.md, knowledge/README.md, INDEX.md) is a Proposal whose criterion is probe_hit_rate_direct >= previous and median_probe_steps <= previous; a regression is rejected even if the prose reads better.
INDEX.md over 200 lines or 25KB fails lint and blocks the readiness report, because content past the limit would be silently unreadable in the harness the children use.
A fact or metric insight without as_of cannot reach status validated. A stale validated fact is downgraded to candidate by lint, with a knowledge.stale event, until refreshed from its source.

Guidance to a child may contain pointers and validated, fresh insights only; it never contains copied raw content from another child's report (the "store interpreted facts only" rule plus provenance).

Permission boundaries are enforced in configuration, not prose: PreToolUse hooks deny writes under validation/ and to live-trading configuration from Mandel and child sessions; market-data keys are read-only where the venue allows; secrets live in .env and are never written to the ledger, the knowledge tree or an audit report (the audit prints key names, never values).
A cadence entry counts as live in reports only if last_execution_event_id is within its interval; a daily-* name or a cron line is not evidence.

Audit and lint scores are compared across runs only when probes.yaml and the lint rule set are unchanged (their hashes are recorded in the report); a rubric change starts a new baseline, exactly like a campaign tag change in 04.

No vector index or graph store may be added to the substrate until an audit shows at least two probes not_found or found_by_fallback for three consecutive runs after routing fixes were attempted; the proposal to add one must cite those reports.
Routing: probe_hit_rate_direct, probe_hit_rate_any, median_probe_steps, per category; trend across audits with matching rubric hash.
Freshness: stale_fraction of validated facts; median_age_days of figures in SYNTHESIS.md; count of live-vs-cache conflicts found by lint.

Structure: index_lines, index_bytes, orphan_count, broken_crosslink_count, contradiction_count, gap_count; context_tokens_at_start as reported by /context for a Mandel session (target: flat or falling as the knowledge tree grows).

Compounding: number of answers filed back per month; fraction of queries answered from the wiki without reopening raw sources; number of insights promoted candidate → validated per cycle (already in cycles.py outcomes).
Procedure health: feedback_rows, fraction_not_ok, feedback_to_proposal_conversion, procedure_regressions_caught_by_probes.
Cadence: procedures per autonomy tier; executions logged vs scheduled; promotions and demotions per period, with the ledger events behind them.
Cost (p06, cycles.py): tokens and dollars per ingest, per query, per lint, per audit; cost per insight validated; share of stage work run on cheaper models.

A score computed on data the optimiser has seen is not evidence, for any model including Mandel itself. Because scikit-learn's base statement ("testing it on the same data is a methodological mistake ... a perfect score") applies to a proposal tuned against the same backtest window that is then used to accept it; gate.evaluate already refuses evidence without out_of_sample=True, and this file is the reason that flag exists.

Three partitions with three roles: train (fit), validation (choose), test (confirm once). Because hyperparameter selection on the test set leaks knowledge of it into the model, and in Mandel every proposal is a hyperparameter of the system; children tune on validation folds, and the gate's final out-of-sample period is a test set that each proposal may consult once.

Count the looks at the hold-out and treat the count as a cost. Because "the more you use the same data to make decisions ... the model implicitly fits the peculiarities of the test set"; n_trials_declared already caps trials per proposal, and the same counter should run per hold-out period across proposals, with the deflated Sharpe ratio's trial count fed from it.

The in-sample versus out-of-sample gap is the overfitting metric, reported on every run. Because "the gap between the training and validation accuracy indicates the amount of overfitting" and the moment the two curves diverge is the diagnostic; a gap_ratio (out-of-sample loss over in-sample loss) belongs next to brier_delta and sharpe_diff in the evidence dict, with a reject threshold.

Early stopping is the default stopping rule for any iterative improvement loop. Because training longer is a capacity increase and the epoch at which validation loss turns is chosen on validation data; a child's or Mandel's own refinement loop halts after patience rounds without validation improvement and reverts to the best-validation state, never to the last state.

Prefer regularisation over a smaller search space, but declare the regulariser before seeing results. Because "the regularization strength is the preferred way to control the overfitting," and because λ, dropout rate and early-stopping patience are hyperparameters that would otherwise be tuned on the test set; they go into the pre-registered criteria body that compute_criteria_hash covers.

Splits follow time and carry an embargo; random shuffles are forbidden on market data. Because KFold and ShuffleSplit "would result in unreasonable correlation between training and testing instances" under autocorrelation and the right test observations are "the 'future' observations least like those that are used to train the model"; walk_forward_splits(n, n_splits, min_train, embargo) is the only splitter the gate accepts, and embargo must exceed the label horizon.

Grouped entities stay on one side of the split. Because validation samples must "come from groups that are not represented at all in the paired training fold"; for Mandel the groups are markets that resolve on the same event (and the same event across venues), which otherwise leak outcomes between train and test.

Fit all preprocessing on the training partition only. Because the same transformation must be applied to "the validation set, test set, and real-world dataset" and fitting a scaler, a feature selector or a liquidity filter on the whole history is a leak; the gate's evidence should name the fit window of every transform.

Stationarity is an assumption to test, not a given, and the feedback loop is real. Because generalization is only promised when "the dataset doesn't change significantly over time" and the crash course's own ticket-pricing example shows predictions changing the thing predicted; every validated result carries as_of, is re-validated on a rolling window, and strategy backtests include a cost-and-impact model.

Positive and negative controls before any real run. Because "train on a tiny portion ... and make sure you can achieve zero cost" catches broken pipelines, and a model that also fits shuffled labels has learned nothing; a child's pipeline must recover a planted signal on synthetic data and must find no edge when outcomes are permuted within time blocks.

Chance-level baselines are explicit numbers, computed first. Because the initial loss should equal −ln(1/C) at chance; for Mandel the reference is the market price at forecast time (skill_vs_market) and the constant-0.5 Brier of 0.25, and a proposal is scored only against those stated baselines.

Metric-consistency invariants are gate checks. Because the creator's own paper reports MAE larger than RMSE, which cannot happen for one series; the gate rejects evidence where RMSE < MAE, Brier ∉ [0,1], log loss < 0, or MurphyDecomposition.reconstructed disagrees with the Brier score beyond tolerance, before looking at any threshold.

Log-scale, random hyperparameter search with declared ranges, and a check of the range edges. Because learning rate and regularisation strength act multiplicatively and random search beats grid search; Mandel's sweeps declare the range in the proposal and flag a winner that sits at a boundary as "search not finished" rather than as a result.

Seeds are hyperparameters and are reported. Because the MLP's loss surface is non-convex and the result depends on initialisation; any child result that cannot be reproduced across seeds within its own confidence interval is a seed effect, and the ledger records the seed with the run.

Capacity is budgeted against independent observations. Because a model "with high capacity fits the noise in the data" and von Neumann's elephant needs only four parameters; each child strategy records its free-parameter count (rules, thresholds, features) against the number of independent out-of-sample periods, and a ratio that would let it fit any labelling is a reason to shrink or regularise before testing.
Anything attributed to this video specifically. The transcript was not reachable; the content above is the canon the title names. Hold the attribution loosely, hold the content firmly.

"Shuffle, then split" as the default split. Correct for i.i.d. data, wrong for Mandel's: the crash course itself concedes that a random split of date-sorted non-stationary data misleads. Rejected for market data in favour of time-ordered, embargoed splits.

"Collect more data" as the first remedy for overfitting. True in the lecture's regime; in Mandel's, more history means older regimes, and more markets means more correlated resolutions. More data helps only when it is from the same distribution, which must be shown, not assumed.

The classical U-shaped capacity curve as a law. Double descent (Nakkiran et al. 2019) shows test error can fall again past the interpolation threshold and that more samples can hurt in some regimes. Mandel measures the generalization curve on its own data rather than assuming its shape; for small tabular models the classical picture is the right prior.

k-fold cross-validation. Attractive for thin data but it violates time order; use it only in its time-series form (walk_forward_splits) and never with shuffling. A single validation split is acceptable when the fold design is honest and declared.

"Use as big a network as your budget allows." CS231n's advice presumes abundant data and a stationary target. For Mandel's children, capacity is a liability per independent observation; the advice is reversed to "use the smallest model that reaches the validation target, regularised."

Universal approximation as a reason to expect a network to learn anything. The theorem says nothing about learnability from finite, noisy, non-stationary data; Mandel does not treat architectural expressiveness as evidence of predictive power.

ReLU as universally better. It is the default for deep networks; dying units and the learning-rate coupling are real, and for the shallow or linear models Mandel's children will mostly run, the choice of activation is a second-order concern next to the split design.

The creator's applied papers as methodological templates. They are competent domain work, but the protocol they report (train/test only, no validation set, undocumented hyperparameter selection, inconsistent tables) is exactly what the lecture's own lesson warns against; Mandel takes the lesson, not the practice.
Any claim that the creator's teaching goes beyond the canon. With coverage at 0.35, assume it does not until shown otherwise.

Three-way temporal partition as a first-class object. Define Partition(train: (t0,t1), validation: (t1+embargo, t2), test: (t2+embargo, t3), embargo: int, fit_windows: dict[transform_name, (t0,t1)]) and attach its hash to every piece of evidence; gate.evaluate rejects evidence whose partition hash is missing or whose test window has been consulted by a prior proposal more than once without a declared re-registration.

Hold-out touch ledger. Add a holdout.touch event to state/ledger.jsonl with {period_id, proposal_id, metric_names}; expose touches(period_id) and feed it as n_trials into expected_max_sharpe / deflated_sharpe_ratio, so the DSR's trial count reflects every look at that period across proposals, not only within one.
