Gap metric in the evidence dict. For strategies: gap_ratio = oos_loss / is_loss with loss = negative mean return or log loss as appropriate; for forecasters: gap_ratio = brier_oos / brier_is. Add Criterion("gap_ratio", "<=", 1.5) to strategy_improvement_criteria and forecast_improvement_criteria (threshold pre-registered per proposal); also record is_score and oos_score separately so the ratio can be audited.

Generalization curve over cycles. In cycles.jsonl, record per cycle the incumbent's in-sample and out-of-sample metric on the current rolling window; a divergence of the two series (out-of-sample worsening for patience cycles while in-sample improves) opens a review proposal automatically, mirroring the loss-curve diagnostic.

Early-stopping protocol for iterative proposals. A proposal that iterates (a child refining a strategy, Mandel tuning a weight) declares patience and max_rounds in its criteria body; the loop stops at the first of the two, and the adopted state is the best-validation round, with the round index logged.

Walk-forward is the only splitter. walk_forward_splits(n, n_splits, min_train, embargo) remains the single supported splitter; add a validation that embargo >= label_horizon and a GroupedWalkForward variant whose groups are event identifiers, so markets resolving on the same event (and cross-venue twins) never straddle a split.

Preprocessing fit-window audit. Every transform in a child's pipeline reports fit_window; the gate rejects evidence where any fit_window end exceeds the training window end. This covers scalers, imputers, feature selection, liquidity filters and any lookup table built from history.

Controls as gate steps. Add positive_control_passed (planted-signal recovery on synthetic data) and shuffle_p (one-sided p-value of the observed edge against a within-block outcome permutation null, blocks matching the embargo) to the evidence dict; Criterion("shuffle_p", "<=", 0.05) and Criterion("positive_control_passed", "==", 1.0) join the standard criteria sets.

Metric invariants before thresholds. In gate.evaluate, before iterating criteria, run check_invariants(ev): RMSE ≥ MAE where both present; 0 ≤ Brier ≤ 1; log loss ≥ 0; murphy_decomposition(...).reconstructed ≈ brier_score(...) within 1e-6; n_resolved equals the length of the scored pairs. A failed invariant is a hard reject with the reason "evidence internally inconsistent."

Declared baselines. The evidence dict names its reference: baseline_kind ∈ {market_price, constant_0.5, incumbent} and baseline_score; skill_vs_market and brier_skill_score are computed only against the declared reference, and a proposal that changes its baseline after pre-registration fails check_integrity.

Regulariser and search ranges inside the criteria hash. Extend the body hashed by Proposal.compute_criteria_hash with regularisation (type and strength), search_space (per-hyperparameter ranges and scale), patience, and seeds; a winner at a range boundary sets search_complete=False and the gate returns "not decided" rather than pass or fail.

Capacity record per child. children.py stores free_parameters (count of tunable rules, thresholds, features and weights) and independent_oos_periods; the ratio is shown in the scoreboard and a ratio above a declared ceiling is a review flag, not a pass/fail, since the right ceiling is itself an empirical question.

Stationarity and impact. Every SourceScore and strategy result carries as_of and window; the gate re-validates incumbents on each new rolling window and demotes any whose out-of-sample score falls outside the confidence band of its original acceptance; strategy backtests must include a declared cost-and-impact model, because Mandel's own trades are part of the data-generating process (the ticket-pricing feedback loop).

Loss choice by target type. Binary market outcomes are scored with log_loss as the primary metric (proper, convex for the logistic unit) and brier_score as the companion, consistent with file 05's adoption; MSE is reserved for continuous targets. The reason is recorded with the scoring module so children do not re-derive it.

Legibility over depth. The lecture's progression (linear → logistic → MLP) is also Mandel's model-selection order: start with the linear or logistic model, adopt a deeper one only when it beats the simpler one on the validation partition by the pre-registered margin and survives the same controls. Each step up in capacity is a proposal with its own gate pass, never a default.

Define a concept by the disagreement between two independent measurements of it, not by a single number or an adjective. Because the video's central slide is exactly this: an integer-valued measure (d_T) and a real-valued one (d_H), and "fractal" names the cases where they differ. Mandel's analogue: a strategy is "overfit" when in-sample and walk-forward scores disagree beyond noise; a forecaster is "miscalibrated" when discrimination and calibration disagree; a child's report is "suspect" when its claimed and reproduced metrics disagree. Record both measures and the gap; never average them into one.

A deferred definition is legitimate if it is labelled as deferred and later discharged. Because the presentation says "it's better to give an informal definition of it for now" and then supplies the formal one two slides later. Mandel keeps the same discipline: an insight may enter the store with an informal statement, but it is tagged candidate, its status is visible, and it cannot be used as a gate criterion until the measurable form exists; "for now" must have an expiry.

Keep integer-valued statuses and real-valued scores as different kinds of measure, and do not let one impersonate the other. Because the slide's footnote "* must be an integer" is the whole point of the contrast: d_T carries one bit of the information that d_H carries as a continuum. Mandel's status fields (candidate / validated / retired) are topological: coarse and discrete. Its scores (Brier, log loss, contraction ratio, confidence) are Hausdorff-like: continuous. A promotion rule that thresholds a score into a status must store the score alongside the status, because the status alone cannot be un-rounded.

A description is understood when a short rule regenerates it; "use linear algebra to generate this shape" is the test, not the picture. Because the video's second half turns from describing the Sierpinski sets to producing them from three or eight small matrices, and the textbook's Example 12 shows the rule regenerating the shape from an arbitrary seed. Mandel stores knowledge as generator plus parameters wherever it can and records the ratio bytes(rule)/bytes(output); an insight that cannot be regenerated from a stated rule is a lookup table.

Two sources that descend from the same canonical text are one source for the purpose of convergence. Because resource 08 is a re-presentation of the same Anton–Rorres §10.11 that resource 09 lectures from; their agreement on every definition is inheritance, not confirmation. Mandel's store.py currently accepts converge:src:08,src:09 because it only checks that two provenance refs are distinct and well-formed. Every knowledge file therefore declares a lineage root, and convergence requires distinct roots. This is the nonoverlap clause of Definition 10.11.1 applied to evidence: overlapping pieces inflate k without adding information.

Compute what a procedure should produce before running it, and treat a mismatch as the finding. Because the dimension formula tells you, before any iteration, that four half-scale maps on a square give a plain square (ln 4/ln 2 = 2 = d_T) while three give a fractal triangle; the chaos game then shows a uniform fill versus a Sierpinski triangle, exactly as predicted. Each Mandel loop records a pre-run prediction (expected contraction, expected size of the validated set, expected direction of a metric) and compares it with the run; "as expected" is only allowed when "expected" was written down first. This is the pre-registration rule, restated for loops rather than proposals.

The attractor is set by the maps, not by the seed; test for it. Because Example 12 builds the triangle from a blob and Hutchinson's theorem guarantees the same limit from every compact seed. Mandel's validated knowledge should be reproducible from its rules regardless of ingestion order; the seed-independence rebuild test specified in resource 09 is kept. (Not independent of 09: same textbook; counts once.)

Convergence is a property of contractions; a loop without a contraction argument runs under a hard cap. Because the theorem's only hypothesis is 0 < s < 1, and without it uniqueness, convergence and seed independence all fail. Every recurring procedure in Mandel either states the metric in which it contracts, with an empirical estimate of s, or carries max_iterations. (Shared with 09; counts once.)

Small one-step errors are amplified by 1/(1 − s); marginal improvements need more evidence, not less. Because the collage theorem bounds the distance to the fixed point by the one-step error times 1/(1 − s), which diverges as the contraction weakens. A proposal claiming s = 0.95 is asserting something whose fixed point is twenty times as sensitive to evaluation noise as one claiming s = 0.5. (Shared with 09; counts once.)

Every map keeps positive probability; weights shape density, never support. Because in the chaos game the probabilities change how densely parts of the attractor are visited and a zero-probability map leaves a hole. Mandel's sampler over proposal classes weights by expected gain with a floor p_min > 0 for every class and logs the realised sampling frequencies so the trial count used for deflation is honest. (Shared with 09; counts once.)

Reject citing this video as an authority for any mathematical statement. It is a student re-presentation of a textbook that itself states theorems without proof; the chain of custody is Hutchinson → Barnsley → Anton–Rorres → Nabil, and Mandel cites the earliest link that actually proves the claim.

Reject counting 08 and 09 as two independent confirmations of anything. Both descend from Anton–Rorres §10.11; agreement between them is inheritance. Until the lineage check exists in code, no insight is promoted to validated on converge:src:08,src:09.

Hold loosely the lecture's "Hausdorff dimension". It is the similarity dimension of an exactly self-similar set with one ratio and nonoverlapping pieces; the general Hausdorff dimension needs Hausdorff measure and coincides with the formula only under the open set condition. The slide's "following the definition of self similar" is that caveat compressed to five words; do not quote the formula as general.

Hold loosely the topological dimensions of the Sierpinski sets (1). True, but asserted in the section without proof; "stated in a textbook" is not the same evidence tier as "proved or measured", and Mandel's confidence field should say which.

Reject the inference "markets are fractal, so IFS or the dimension formula applies to prices". The formula requires exact self-similarity, one scale factor and nonoverlap; price series are at most statistically self-affine with scale-dependent exponents and heavy noise. Anything "fractal" about a market is an estimated exponent with a confidence interval, a declared scale range and a beaten null, as resources 15 and A4 specify, never a borrowed formula.

Reject the IFS as a model of learning or "self-expansion". Once the maps are fixed, iteration produces detail and no information; learning is the inverse problem (choosing maps from data), which the collage theorem bounds but does not solve and which is unsolved in general. Mandel measures self-improvement as validated information gained, never as volume of output.

Hold loosely the claim, common in this genre of student project, that "all fractals come from some iterated function system". Escape-time sets (Mandelbrot, Julia; resource 16) and random fractals are not IFS attractors; the IFS attractor is a special, exactly self-similar case, and resource 15 is explicit that self-similarity is the exception among fractals.

Hold loosely "probability proportional to area" for the chaos game. It is a rendering heuristic, not a theorem about allocation; Mandel's analogue (sampling proposal classes by expected gain) needs its own validation, and the only hard rule is the positive floor.

Hold loosely every item marked [textbook] as something the video says. The frames establish structure and three slides; the rest is inference from the section the slides copy. If a transcript ever becomes reachable, re-read this file against it first.
Hold loosely the 2024-02-13 date. It is the date a third-party vote-tracking service first created a record for the video, which bounds the upload date from above but is not it.

Reject visual plausibility as evidence. An IFS draws a convincing fern from 28 numbers; a model that reproduces the look of a price chart has predicted nothing. The only admissible evidence is an out-of-sample score against a null.

SourceLineage (one record per knowledge file, stored in a small table under mandel/knowledge/ and loaded by ingest.py from a lineage: header line in each file): {ref: "src:08", lineage_root: "anton-rorres-ela-10.11", derivation: "re-presentation" | "lecture" | "original" | "survey", derived_from: ["src:09"] or canonical citations, independence_notes}. This file's record: root anton-rorres-ela-10.11, derivation re-presentation; resource 09's record carries the same root with derivation lecture.

Insight.measures: list[{name, value, kind: "count" | "ratio" | "exponent" | "score" | "status"}] so that an insight asserting a property of a thing can carry the two measurements that define it, and Insight.disagreement: {measure_a, measure_b, gap, noise_estimate} for insights whose content *is* a disagreement (overfit, miscalibration, reproduction failure). A single-measure "fractal / self-similar / overfit" claim is incomplete by schema.
Insight.definition_status: "informal" | "formal" with formal_by: date | proposal id. An informal insight may be stored, searched and cited in a proposal's rationale; it may not be a gate Criterion.

LoopSpec.pre_run_prediction: {metric, predicted_value_or_direction, basis} and LoopSpec.post_run: {observed, miss} for every recurring procedure, alongside the convergence_argument, max_iterations and seed_sensitivity fields from 09.

Insight.generator: {rule_ref, params, params_bytes} and output_bytes (from 09), with the added rule that an insight whose generator is null is tagged lookup and capped at confidence 0.5 like a mandel:self claim.

*Lineage audit at ingest.* ingest_file reads the lineage: header; a file without one is ingested with lineage_root = ref (itself) and a warning in the ingest report. A nightly audit lists every pair of sources sharing a root and every insight whose validated_by contains a converge: whose refs share a root; such insights are demoted to candidate with a ledger entry naming the shared root.

*Deferred-definition expiry.* A weekly pass lists insights with definition_status == "informal" older than a registered horizon (suggest 30 days) and either proposes the formal form or retires the insight; "for now" is enforced to mean for now.

*Predict-then-run.* Every scheduled loop writes pre_run_prediction to the ledger before it starts (hash-anchored like a proposal's criteria), then post_run; the cycle summary reports miss and the loop's running miss rate. A loop that has never missed in many runs is predicting too loosely and its prediction is tightened; one that misses often has a model problem, which is itself a candidate insight.

*Regenerate-from-rules spot check.* Each cycle samples a few insights that carry a generator and re-runs the generator; a mismatch between the regenerated output and the stored output retires the insight (the rule no longer produces the claim) and records why.

*Seed-independence rebuild and contraction bookkeeping* as specified in 09; this file adds that the rebuild is also run after any change to ingest.py or the lineage table, since those change the operator whose fixed point the validated set is supposed to be.

set_status(..., by="converge:a,b") requires lineage_root(a) != lineage_root(b); otherwise it raises, with a message naming the shared root. Convergence of three refs of which two share a root counts as two.
A Criterion in gate.py may not reference an insight whose definition_status is informal; the gate reports this as a pre-registration failure, not a measurement failure.
Any insight or child report that uses the words "fractal", "self-similar", "scale-free" or "overfit" must carry two named measures and their gap, or it stays candidate with the tag single-measure.
A loop without a pre_run_prediction may run, but its results may not be described as "expected" in a proposal's evidence and do not count toward "as predicted" in cycle summaries.

Where a status is derived from a score by threshold (candidate → validated on a confidence bound, strategy → adopted on a contraction CI), the score, the threshold and the date are stored with the status; a status with no stored score is treated as informal.
Pooled confidence across insights is computed over distinct lineage roots only; two insights from one root contribute as one.

lineage_redundancy: share of validated insights whose only validation is a converge: with refs sharing a root (target 0; the current value should be computed once as a baseline, since 08 and 09 are already in the store).
informal_criteria_count: number of gate criteria referencing informal insights (target 0).
prediction_miss_rate per loop and overall; also prediction_tightness (how often the observed value fell inside the predicted interval), to catch vacuous predictions.

The 09 metrics (contraction_ratio, seed_sensitivity, compressibility, overlap_fraction, exploration_floor_hits) are kept unchanged.

The attractor is a property of the maps, not of the seed (Example 12). Mandel's validated knowledge set should be reproducible from its *rules* (ingestion, validation gate, scoring) regardless of the order in which children's reports or sources arrived, because a knowledge state that depends on arrival order is an artefact of history, not of evidence. Test it: rebuild from a permuted seed and compare.

Convergence is guaranteed only for contractions (Theorem 10.11.1). Every iterative loop in Mandel (re-validation, proposal → evaluate → accept, children's feedback) must either come with a convergence argument or be run under a hard iteration cap and an empirical contraction check, because fixed-point iteration without contraction has no uniqueness or convergence guarantee and can wander.

Measure the contraction factor of each improvement. For an accepted proposal record s = err_after/err_before on held-out data; s < 1 with a confidence interval is the honest definition of "improved", because the whole theory of the section rests on s < 1, and "error went down on the training window" is not that.

Error amplification 1/(1 − s) (collage theorem). When improvements are marginal (s near 1), small evaluation noise is amplified into large uncertainty about where the loop is converging, so the gate must demand more evidence (larger n, more walk-forward folds) for small claimed gains than for large ones, because the bound says the fixed point can be ε/(1 − s) away from the target even when each step looks ε-close.

Compression as a quality signal (28 numbers regenerate a fern). Store knowledge as generative rules plus parameters wherever possible, and track bytes(rules)/bytes(output); an insight that cannot be regenerated from a short rule is a lookup table, not understanding. This is the operational form of the Kolmogorov/Solomonoff names already in children.py.

Nonoverlap before counting (Definition 10.11.1, Example 13). The dimension formula fails when pieces overlap; likewise evidence pooled from overlapping sources (two children citing the same backtest, two articles quoting one study) must be deduplicated before it counts toward confidence, because overlap inflates k without adding information.

Two measures disagreeing is itself information (Definition 10.11.3). "Fractal" is defined by d_H ≠ d_T. Mandel should treat disagreement between metrics (Brier vs log loss, calibration vs discrimination, Sharpe vs drawdown) as a diagnostic to record, not an inconsistency to average away.

Exploration with positive probability everywhere (chaos game). Random sampling of which proposal class to evaluate next converges on the same validated set as exhaustive search only if every class keeps positive probability; weight classes by expected "area" (expected gain) but never to zero, because a map with probability zero leaves a hole in the attractor.

Algorithms come after existence theorems. The section proves (states) that the object exists and is unique before giving two ways to compute it. Mandel should write the acceptance criterion (what "the improved system" is) before writing the procedure that searches for it; this is already the pre-registration rule in proposals.py, and the section is a clean mathematical instance of why.

Reject the inference "markets are fractal, therefore the dimension formula or IFS models apply to prices". The formula d_H = ln k/ln(1/s) requires exact self-similarity with one scale factor and nonoverlapping pieces; price series are at best statistically self-affine with scale-dependent exponents and heavy noise. Anything "fractal" about markets must be an estimated scaling exponent with a confidence interval and an out-of-sample check (see resources 11–14), not a borrowed formula.

Reject the user's framing of an IFS as an "infinitely self-expanding, learning" model. An IFS attractor has infinite detail and zero new information: once the 28 numbers are fixed, iteration produces complexity, not knowledge. Learning is the *inverse* problem (choosing the maps from data), which Wikipedia correctly describes as unsolved in general and which the collage theorem only bounds. Mandel's "self-expansion" must be measured as validated information gained, never as volume of output generated.

Hold loosely "Hausdorff dimension" as defined in the lecture. It is the similarity dimension; the general Hausdorff dimension is defined via Hausdorff measure and only coincides with it under the open set condition. Do not quote the lecture's definition as the general one.

Hold loosely the convergence analogy for RSI. Theorem 10.11.1 needs contractions on a complete metric space. A self-improvement loop operating on code and files has no natural metric in which it is a contraction; the analogy motivates measuring s, it does not license assuming convergence.

Hold loosely the claim that topological dimension of the Sierpinski sets is 1. It is true, but asserted without proof in the section; Mandel should not treat "stated in a textbook" as the same evidence tier as "proved or measured".

Reject estimating fractal dimension from small samples as a trading feature without a null. Box-counting or Hurst estimates on finite windows are biased and noisy; a fractional-Brownian-motion null (graph dimension D = 2 − H, so D = 1.5 for a memoryless random walk) must be beaten out of sample before any such estimate counts as signal.

Hold loosely the chaos-game rule of thumb "probability proportional to area". It is a heuristic for rendering density, not a theorem about optimal allocation; Mandel's analogue (sampling proposals by expected gain) needs its own validation.

ContractionEvidence (added to the evidence dict a proposal records before decide): {metric, err_before, err_after, s: err_after/err_before, s_ci: [lo, hi], holdout_id, n_obs}. The gate reads s_ci[1] < 1, not s < 1.

LoopSpec (one per recurring procedure in Mandel, stored under mandel/knowledge/ and referenced from the ledger): {name, state_space, metric, convergence_argument: "proof"|"empirical"|"none", contraction_estimate, max_iterations, seed_sensitivity}. A loop with convergence_argument == "none" may run only with max_iterations set.

Insight (in store.py) gains generator: {rule_ref, params, params_bytes} and output_bytes, so compressibility = params_bytes / output_bytes can be computed; and overlap_group: str so insights derived from the same underlying evidence are counted once.

ScalingEstimate (candidate insight type): {series_id, estimator: "box_count"|"hurst_rs"|"dfa"|"variance_ratio", scale_range: [min, max], exponent, ci, null_exponent, oos_window, oos_exponent}. Never promoted to validated unless oos_exponent lies within ci and ci excludes null_exponent.
Child.metrics (in children.py) gains reported_overlap_groups: list[str] so Mandel can detect two children reporting the same evidence.

*Seed-independence rebuild* (periodic): replay the ledger's candidate insights into a fresh InsightStore in two or more permuted orders and compare the resulting validated sets; store seed_sensitivity = 1 − Jaccard(set_a, set_b). If it exceeds a registered threshold, the validation operator is order-dependent and the loop is flagged in its LoopSpec (this is Example 12 as a regression test).

*Contraction bookkeeping*: every decide(passed=True) requires ContractionEvidence; Mandel keeps a running geometric mean of accepted s values per target (strategy, forecast source, code module) as its convergence-rate estimate. A target whose recent s values drift toward 1 is "stalled"; one with any s > 1 on held-out data triggers roll_back.

*Chaos-game proposal sampler*: when choosing which proposal class to evaluate next, sample with probability p_i ∝ expected gain of class i, floored at p_min > 0 for every class (exploration floor). Log the sampling probabilities in the ledger so that n_trials_declared and the realised trial counts can be reconciled for the Deflated Sharpe Ratio.

*Collage check for compositional models*: before adopting any model built as "a union of rescaled copies of the same component" (multi-timescale strategies, hierarchical ensembles), compute the one-step collage error ε (how well the union of components reproduces the held-out data) and the contraction factor s, and report the bound ε/(1 − s) alongside the headline metric.
code_change_criteria() and strategy_improvement_criteria() in gate.py gain a criterion contraction_ci_upper < 1 fed from ContractionEvidence; a proposal without it cannot leave evaluating.

Minimum evidence scales with marginality: for a claimed s in [0.9, 1), require at least twice the walk-forward folds and the full block_bootstrap_pvalue test; small gains get more scrutiny, not less (the 1/(1 − s) amplification).
A proposal that introduces a new loop must attach a LoopSpec; convergence_argument == "none" without max_iterations is a gate failure.

Scaling-exponent insights require: estimation over at least two decades of scale, a bootstrap CI, a stated null (fBm with H = 0.5, i.e. graph dimension 1.5, for memoryless series), and an out-of-sample reproduction. Otherwise they stay candidate.
Pooled confidence across insights is computed over distinct overlap_groups only (nonoverlap before counting).
Any claim phrased as "the system is fractal / self-similar" must name the two measures that disagree and report both; a single number is not a fractal claim.
contraction_ratio (per accepted proposal) and its running geometric mean per target; stall_count (proposals with s in [0.95, 1)).
seed_sensitivity (Jaccard distance between validated sets rebuilt from permuted seeds); target near 0.
compressibility per insight and its distribution across the store; a rising median is a sign of understanding, a falling one of memorisation.
overlap_fraction of evidence (share of insights sharing an overlap_group with another).
exploration_floor_hits (how often the sampler fell back to p_min), to detect classes being starved.
For time series: estimated scaling exponent with CI vs null, by series and by window, kept as diagnostics, never as features until validated.

Every stored quantity is a vector with a declared basis ("the notation contract"). Forecast vectors, feature rows, children's reports and market snapshots get an explicit schema naming each coordinate and its unit, because a vector is only meaningful relative to a basis, and silent basis mismatch is the linear-algebra form of a schema bug.

Similarity is an angle, measured against a same-model baseline. Deduplicate insights, cluster children's claims and detect near-identical strategy variants by cosine similarity with thresholds calibrated on the angle distribution of that embedding model, because random high-dimensional directions concentrate near 90° and only the deviation from the model's own baseline is informative.

Count independent signals, not signals (rank discipline). Before any strategy comparison or ensemble, compute the effective rank of the feature or forecast matrix and the eigenvalues of its correlation matrix, because "a column that is a combination of others adds no rank", and the deflated-Sharpe trial count and ensemble value both depend on the number of independent trials, not the number of named ones.

Residuals must be orthogonal to what they were fit on. After any least-squares calibration (e.g., mapping a child's probabilities to calibrated ones), assert Xᵀe ≈ 0 and residual-sum ≈ 0 when an intercept is present, because these identities are free, exact diagnostics that catch leakage, wrong design matrices and broken solvers.

Never form an explicit inverse; solve, and log the condition number. Validation and calibration code uses np.linalg.solve / lstsq, and records cond(XᵀX), because an ill-conditioned design means coefficients are noise even when fits look good, and Batra's Hilbert-matrix footnote shows the failure is silent.

Low rank as a compression principle with a measured error bound. When Mandel compresses knowledge (summaries of children's logs, factor models of correlated markets), it keeps the top-k components and reports the discarded σ-tail, because Eckart–Young gives the best approximation and tells you exactly what was lost; compression without a stated loss is not accepted.

Centre and state units before any PCA or variance claim. Explained-variance figures are reported with the standardisation used, because the same housing data gives 99.9% or 46% depending on units, and an unstandardised "dominant factor" is usually just the largest-scaled column.

Symmetric matrices get spectral treatment. Covariance matrices of children's forecast errors and Hessians of calibration losses are diagonalised, and their eigenvalue spectra stored, because the spectrum tells Mandel whether children are redundant (one dominant eigenvalue) or diverse (flat spectrum), and curvature bounds learning rates.

A chain of linear re-weightings is one re-weighting. Mandel's pipelines earn depth only through nonlinear steps (gates, thresholds, validation decisions), because a 100-layer linear network "is secretly one matrix" and the same collapse applies to stacked linear combinations of forecasts.

Repeated application converges to the dominant direction at rate λ₂/λ₁. Mandel treats its self-improvement loop as an operator applied repeatedly and tracks whether metrics are converging, oscillating or diverging, because power iteration is the simplest model of what a loop of updates does in the long run, and the spectral gap, not the step count, sets how fast it settles.

Picture → numbers → code → symbols, with one numeric check per claim. Every knowledge-file formula and every proposal's evidence includes a reproducible numeric check (finite differences, np.allclose, measured error vs predicted bound), because Batra's materials show that the cheapest way to catch a wrong closed form is to compute it two ways.

The exact enumeration and order of the "seven". Reconstructed from Batra's course spec, not from the video. The eight-minute format may merge projection into least squares, or split SVD and PCA. Low-stakes, but the file should be marked "unverified enumeration" until a transcript is read.

"Learning = approximation" as a slogan. True for Eckart–Young on a fixed matrix, but in Mandel's setting an approximation that fits the observed matrix well is exactly what overfitting looks like; Batra's own matrix-factorisation sheet says so ("too many factors fit the known ratings exactly and guess the rest"). Approximation quality on held-out cells, not in-sample, is what the gate scores.

Low-rank structure in prediction markets is a hypothesis, not a given. Image spectra "fall off a cliff" and LoRA updates concentrate energy, but binary event outcomes, thin order books and regime changes need not. Mandel measures the spectrum of its own price/forecast matrices before using a factor model, and treats a flat spectrum as a finding, not a failure.

PageRank-style credit assignment for children. Appealing ("important is circular, and that's the good part") but an eigenvector of a who-cites-whom graph rewards mutual agreement, which is a self-confirmation risk in an RSI loop. Any such score needs damping, external resolution-based scoring as the ground truth, and should be advisory only.

Power-iteration intuition for the RSI loop. Convergence to a top eigenvector assumes a fixed linear operator; Mandel's operator changes with every accepted proposal and is not linear. Use it as a diagnostic metaphor (is the loop settling, and how fast), not as a convergence guarantee.

Cosine similarity as a universal measure. It is scale-invariant, which is a feature for text embeddings and a bug for forecasts, where magnitude (how far from 0.5) is the whole point. Use angles for "is this the same claim", not for "is this the same forecast".

SVD compression of knowledge. The σ-tail that truncation discards is where rare, low-variance structure lives, and in trading rare structure includes tail risk. Knowledge compression must keep an explicit exceptions list outside the low-rank part.

Linear algebra gives geometry, not causality or calibration. Projection onto a column space finds the best linear fit regardless of whether the columns cause anything or whether the fitted probabilities are calibrated. Those are separate gates.
FeatureMatrix / ForecastMatrix objects carry a basis manifest (ordered coordinate names, units, available_at semantics) alongside the array; a matrix without a basis manifest cannot enter validation.

ForecastBook gains error_matrix(sources, questions) (sources × resolved questions, entries = forecast − outcome) and source_correlation(); the eigenvalues of the correlation matrix give n_effective = (Σλ)² / Σλ² (participation ratio) and effective_rank(tol) (count of singular values above tol · σ₁). n_effective feeds deflated_sharpe_ratio(n_trials=...) and the ensemble weights, replacing raw counts of sources or strategy variants.

Insights in InsightStore carry an embedding vector plus the embedding_model id; cosine deduplication thresholds are stored per model, calibrated from that model's random-pair angle distribution (Batra's "same embedding model, not a universal 90° rule").

A LowRankSummary record for any compressed object: k, sigma (full spectrum), tail_energy = Σ_{i>k} σᵢ² / Σ σᵢ², centred: bool, standardisation, and an exceptions list of rows deliberately kept outside the low-rank part.

The improvement loop logs a per-iteration state vector (gate pass rate, log loss vs market, calibration error, resource cost) and a convergence diagnostic: ratio of successive change norms, which is the empirical analogue of λ₂/λ₁. A ratio near 1 (not settling) or above 1 (diverging) blocks declaring a "stable" version.

Cross-venue price matrices (Polymarket vs Kalshi, same underlying question, over time) are modelled as rank-1 plus residual; the residual, not the raw spread, is the arbitrage candidate, and a persistent residual that does not revert is first treated as a contract-definition mismatch to investigate, not as free money.

Children's forecasts are combined by a method that is nonlinear somewhere (calibration map, gating on n_effective, or stacking with held-out weights), never by a chain of linear re-weightings, which would collapse to one.

Any proposal whose evidence includes regression coefficients must attach effective_rank, cond(XᵀX) and the residual-orthogonality check (max |Xᵀe| / (‖X‖‖e‖) below 1e-8); coefficient interpretations from rank-deficient designs are rejected, though the fitted ŷ may still be used (Batra: many θ̂, one ŷ).
A lint rule in mandel/validation: no np.linalg.inv applied to a design or covariance matrix; use solve, lstsq or eigh.
PCA or factor claims require centred=True and an explicit standardisation; explained-variance numbers reported without units are rejected.

Any low-rank module ships a self-test asserting measured truncation error equals the predicted σ-tail to float tolerance (the Eckart–Young check Batra runs in-slide); a module whose test fails is not numerically trustworthy regardless of backtest results.
Every closed-form gradient used in calibration code is checked against central finite differences in the test suite ((f(t+he) − f(t−he)) / 2h), per the "Maths for ML" cheatsheet's practice.

effective_rank, n_effective, cond_number, tail_energy, residual_orthogonality, convergence_ratio, and per-model cosine-baseline statistics are first-class metrics in the ledger, so a later Mandel can see whether a gain in Sharpe coincided with a drop in independence.

Declare the state. Every predictive model, backtest and proposal names the state variable its transition rules condition on, because the Markov property is a modelling choice about what to remember, and an undeclared state is where look-ahead and omitted feedback hide.

Dependence is measured, never assumed away (the Nekrasov rule). Before any law-of-large-numbers argument ("over 500 trades the mean edge is significant"), estimate the autocorrelation and report n_eff = n(1−ρ)/(1+ρ) (or the block-bootstrap equivalent), because independence is the one assumption Nekrasov made that was false, and it is the default assumption of every dashboard.

Dependent sequences still have laws; use the ergodic theorem, not the iid one. Walk-forward and block-bootstrap results are averaged over dependent samples and are valid as long as the chain mixes; Mandel states the mixing assumption rather than pretending the samples are independent, because that is exactly what Markov's 1906 paper licenses and no more.

Simulate when the closed form is out of reach; report N and the standard error. Monte Carlo is already the bootstrap in validation/backtest_eval.py; every Monte Carlo quantity Mandel reports carries its sample count, seed and σ/√N, because an estimate without its error is Ulam's hundred games with the count forgotten.

A Markov baseline is the null model. For any state-conditioned forecaster (price buckets, time-to-resolution, order-book regime), fit the first-order transition-count model with smoothing and require the candidate to beat it on held-out log loss, because a count table is the cheapest model that respects dependence, and a forecaster that cannot beat it has learned nothing beyond "where am I now".

Mixing time is a diagnostic. For any chain Mandel fits or runs (market-state chains, the proposal lifecycle, a child's strategy-state sequence), compute |λ₂| and the implied mixing time and record whether the sample is long enough for the long-run frequencies to mean anything, because the cutoff phenomenon says a chain can look unmixed for a long time and then mix abruptly, and the deck is not random after five shuffles even though it looks shuffled.

Order grows only with data (Shannon's trade-off). Context length, lag count and feature history are chosen by held-out log loss, not by the intuition that more history is better, because a k-th-order chain has |S|ᵏ states and the counts go sparse long before the intuition does.

Damp every self-referential score. Any importance, trust or credit score defined circularly (children citing children, insights supporting insights) gets a teleportation term and an external anchor in resolved outcomes, because PageRank is only well-posed with damping, and without the anchor the eigenvector rewards closed loops of mutual agreement.

Name the feedback loop you are inside. Insights derived from Mandel's own outputs are tagged origin=mandel-self and their share is bounded, and tail cases are kept out of any compression, because the video's model-collapse example is a loop Mandel is structurally inside, and the mechanism is loss of the tails.

"Random enough" has a metric; pre-register it. Whether a shuffle, a bootstrap or a forecast is "good enough" depends on the distance chosen (total variation gives seven shuffles, other metrics give four or six); Mandel's gate criteria name the metric before the measurement, which ProposalBook.preregister already enforces.

Convergence from any start, or say so. A result that depends on the initial state or seed is not a stationary property; proposals are evaluated from multiple seeds and start dates, because the Onegin chain's whole argument is that the destination does not depend on the first letter.

"Predicts (almost) anything." Markov models predict distributions and long-run frequencies, not trajectories. In markets the stationary distribution of a price is close to uninformative (a fair price is a martingale), and the edge, if any, is in conditional transitions the market has not priced. The title is a hook; the mechanism is narrower.

Stationarity of the transition matrix. Onegin's P does not change between chapter one and chapter eight; a market's does. A chain fitted on one regime is a different chain in the next, and the gate must test transition-matrix drift (total-variation distance between P estimated on adjacent windows) before trusting any long-run frequency. The video's examples are all stationary systems; Mandel's are not.

"Feedback loops break Markov chains." They break small-state chains. State augmentation restores the property at the cost of state explosion; the honest statement is "we have omitted a state variable", which is a model-specification error, not a limit of the mathematics.

"LLMs are modified Markov chains." Formally true over the context window and mechanically misleading; the transition rule is a learned function, not a count table, and nothing in Markov chain theory (mixing, stationarity) transfers in a useful way. Mandel uses it as lineage, not as a model of its own children.

Dependence always converges, so dependence is fine. The video's example (negative autocorrelation) converges faster than iid. Positive autocorrelation, the common case in returns, volatility and child reports, converges slower and shrinks the effective sample. Mandel treats dependence as a cost to be measured, never as a comfort.

Seven shuffles as a universal constant. The number is metric-dependent (four to eight across reasonable choices). The analogous Mandel traps are "p < 0.05" and "DSR > 0.95" as if they were properties of the strategy rather than of the chosen test.

The historical frame. 1906 (dependent LLN) and 1913 (Onegin) are separate papers; Monte Carlo had precursors (Fermi, Buffon's needle, Student's 1908 simulations); ENIAC's "first" is contestable; Markov's politics are flattened. Low stakes for Mandel, but a reminder that a well-told story is not a validated claim.

Memorylessness as a virtue. For Mandel it is a budget decision: what to carry forward between sessions. The Markov property says a compact state suffices *if it is the right state*; it does not say that the context Mandel is about to drop was irrelevant.

MarkovBaseline (new, mandel/models/markov.py): {state_spec: {variable, discretisation, n_states}, order: k, counts: (|S|ᵏ × |S|) int matrix, smoothing_alpha, P: row-stochastic matrix, pi: stationary distribution, lambda2_abs, mixing_time_steps (smallest t with |λ₂|ᵗ < 0.01), fit_window: [start, end], n_transitions}. Fitting a baseline on the same walk-forward splits as the candidate is the first step of every forecaster proposal; the candidate's brier_skill_score and log-loss delta are reported against both the market price and this baseline.

DependenceReport (new, attached to every return or forecast-error series the gate sees): {n, rho_1, rho_block (Ljung–Box at lags 1..L), n_eff = n(1−ρ₁)/(1+ρ₁), recommended_block_length (Politis–White or ≈ n^{1/3}), stationarity_pvalue}. block_bootstrap_pvalue and deflated_sharpe_ratio take n_eff, not n; forecast_improvement_criteria(min_n=30) compares against n_eff.

Proposal (extend): state_manifest: {variables[], available_at semantics, omitted_known_feedbacks[]}. preregister refuses a forecaster or strategy proposal without one; omitted_known_feedbacks must be an explicit list (possibly empty with a reason), because an omitted state is the failure mode of item 13.

MonteCarloRun (new ledger kind mc.completed): {purpose, seed, n_samples, estimate, std_error = σ/√N, target_std_error, converged: bool}. The gate rejects any Monte Carlo evidence whose std_error exceeds the pre-registered target or whose seed and N are missing.

Insight.origin (extend store.py): enum {external, child, mandel-self, derived} plus derivation_depth (number of Mandel-generated hops from an external or resolved-outcome anchor). InsightStore.summary() reports the share of mandel-self insights and the depth distribution.

TransitionDrift (new, periodic): for each MarkovBaseline, P estimated on consecutive windows; tv_distance = ½ Σᵢ πᵢ Σⱼ |P_ij^(t) − P_ij^(t−1)|, logged as a time series; a drift above a registered threshold marks every insight that depends on that chain stale (ties to principle 10, "entropy is the default").

*Baseline-first forecasting loop*: discretise → fit MarkovBaseline on the train split → score it on the held-out split with log_loss and brier_score → record as the floor → only then evaluate the candidate. A candidate that does not beat the floor on held-out log loss is rejected with reason below_markov_baseline regardless of its story.

*Proposal lifecycle as a chain*: the states drafted → preregistered → measured → {accepted, rejected, withdrawn} → (accepted →) {stable, rolled_back} form a chain over ledger events; Mandel estimates its transition counts monthly, reports the stationary acceptance and regret rates, and treats a rising accepted → rolled_back probability as the earliest sign the gate is too loose.

*Teleportation in proposal selection*: when choosing which champion or idea to extend (the campaign loop in resource 04), sample the parent with probability 0.85 by score and 0.15 uniformly from the archive, because without the random jump the loop is a spider trap on the current champion; the 0.85 is a starting value to be tuned, not a constant.

*Mixing check before trusting frequencies*: any report of a long-run frequency (hit rate by regime, acceptance rate, child reliability) is accompanied by the chain's mixing_time_steps and the sample length; if the sample is shorter than ~10 mixing times the frequency is labelled pre-mixing and cannot be cited as validated.

*Self-reference audit*: when the share of origin=mandel-self insights among those cited by accepted proposals exceeds a registered cap (initially 30%), the loop pauses knowledge compression and schedules external-source ingestion, because model collapse is driven by the ratio of self-generated to fresh data.
Gate: n_eff, not n, satisfies minimum-sample criteria; block length for block_bootstrap_pvalue is taken from DependenceReport, never a default constant.

Gate: forecaster proposals must report held-out log loss against (a) the market price at forecast time and (b) the MarkovBaseline; both deltas must be negative (better) with the pre-registered margin.

Gate: a proposal whose state_manifest.omitted_known_feedbacks is non-empty must include a sensitivity check showing the omission does not flip the sign of the result, or be scoped to a regime where the omitted variable is constant.
Gate: Monte Carlo evidence requires seed, n_samples and std_error and converged=True; a p-value from fewer than 1,000 resamples is insufficient_mc.
Gate: results must be reproduced from at least two seeds and two start dates with the same sign (the "converges from any start" rule); divergence is initialisation_dependent.
Store: insights with derivation_depth ≥ 3 and no resolved-outcome anchor cap at confidence 0.5 and are never propagated to children.

Every pre-registered criterion names its metric and threshold before measurement (already enforced); the knowledge file for any test records which alternative metrics would have given a different verdict, as Bayer–Diaconis vs. Trefethen do for shuffles.
Per fitted chain: lambda2_abs, mixing_time_steps, pi, tv_drift over time, and the held-out log loss of the chain as a baseline.
Per evidence series: rho_1, n_eff / n, recommended block length.
Per Monte Carlo run: std_error, n_samples, time cost (ties to principle 6, information has a cost).

Substrate-level: proposal-chain stationary acceptance and regret rates; mandel-self insight share and mean derivation_depth; number of forecaster proposals rejected as below_markov_baseline (a healthy loop rejects many).
Honesty marker in readiness reports: "Markov baselines fitted: N; candidates that beat them out of sample: M; chains with tv_drift above threshold this period: K."

Every component is typed deterministic or stochastic, and the type fixes how it may be evaluated. Because a backtest is only meaningful for a replayable decision function; evidence of the wrong kind (a backtest offered for a model-in-the-loop component, or an anecdote offered for a rule) is rejected by the gate.

The model designs and interprets; code computes and executes. Because this is the one pattern across all of the creator's systems that survived two years, and it is also the pattern that makes the live-money path auditable.

Stochastic components are scored as forecasters, not backtested. Because the creator's honest "not backtested" is the right answer for an LLM research layer; Mandel's equivalent is Brier and log loss against the market price on resolved, held-out questions (mandel.validation.scoring), with a minimum n before any claim.

Pin and log every model call. Model id, prompt hash, temperature, seed, input hash, raw output, tokens, dollars, timestamp. Because "non-deterministic" is not an excuse; it is a quantity to measure, and residual variance across k replays is itself a fitness metric for whether that component may sit anywhere near a decision.

A fixed cadence and a dollar budget per interpretation pass. Because one scheduled call per day at about $1 beat a chat loop on cost and on discipline; Mandel's cycles already log cost, and the cost per validated improvement is a tracked metric.

Monitoring is deterministic predicates in versioned config; the model writes the summary, never the action. Because alerts on targets, stops and IV are the part of his stack that is reproducible and testable; the narrative layer on top is useful and unverifiable.

Turn discretionary claims into dials, pre-register the trial count, sample the space, then pay for the search. Because the 258M-configuration space with a 25,000-sample is exactly the multiple-testing setting deflated_sharpe_ratio and expected_max_sharpe exist for, and because the creator's version lacked the correction that would make its survivors believable.

Report survivors against the chance baseline. expected_false_positives = n_trials × alpha; a sweep whose survivor count is at or below that number is recorded as "no edge found," whatever the best configuration looks like. Because 1.7% of 25,000 is a noise-level result until shown otherwise.

Transaction costs are mandatory, non-null fields in every backtest, and a strategy must survive a friction stress test. Fees, spread or slippage, and fill probability; for prediction markets, the taker fee schedule and the probability of being filled at the quoted price; then re-run at 2x the assumed friction. Because the creator's inclusion of commissions and slippage is part of why his negative result is credible, and because independent practitioners put default-settings optimism at 30–50% of backtest Sharpe.

Simplicity prior with a trades-per-parameter floor. Prefer rules with few free parameters and frequent signals; require a registered minimum number of trades per free parameter (a rule of thumb, mine, to be tuned) before a configuration is eligible. Because the survivors in his test were simple and frequent, and because frequent signals give the sample size that makes any statistic meaningful.

Popular win-rate claims enter as hypotheses with the claimed number attached. Because 70–80% became 52% under test; Mandel records the claim, the test, and the gap as a negative insight so the children do not re-import it.

Specific, bounded instructions to children and to models. Account constraints, risk tolerance, scoring factors, data sources, and the output schema are stated before any analysis is requested. Because the creator found generic prompts produced generic output, and because a bounded request is the only kind whose answer can be checked.

Interrogate the spec before pre-registration. A proposal that touches strategy logic must answer a fixed question set (data source and point-in-time availability, timeframe, exact entry, exact exit, edge cases such as halts, gaps, stale quotes and resolution disputes) before preregister() will accept it. Because three independent practitioners report that unresolved decisions, not bad code, were their main source of rework, and an unanswered question is where look-ahead hides.

Trade and cycle review runs over structured logs, not memory. Because the one use of the model the creator trusts most is reviewing records of what was done; Mandel's ledger and cycle log are those records.

Project memory lives in a file read at session start, and that file is itself gated. Because CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md-style memory is the practitioner consensus for making a fresh session competent, MANDEL.md already plays that role, and a memory file nobody validates becomes a prompt that quietly rewrites behaviour.

Temperature and model are chosen per role and recorded. Low temperature for evaluators, scorers and code that will be replayed; higher for hypothesis generation; the setting is a logged field, not a default. Because reproducibility of the stochastic layer is partly a dial Mandel controls, and the record is what lets replay variance be attributed.

A regime-coverage requirement on strategy evidence. A backtest must report trades and performance in at least trending, ranging, high-volatility and low-volatility buckets (or Mandel's own regime labels), and a proposal with evidence from one regime only is not eligible for adoption. Because post-hoc regime filters are the most common in-sample repair in the genre, and because a MarkovBaseline per regime (file 11) is the natural null.
Human decides on live money. Already principle 13 in MANDEL.md; this resource is an independent practitioner arriving at the same rule after two years.

The headline return (+155% in one month). One month, long-dated calls on small caps, a strong tape, one account, self-reported, research not backtested. It is an outcome, not evidence of a method; a single such month is well within the dispersion of leveraged option books with no edge. Mandel records it as an anecdote with no insight weight.

"Non-deterministic research" as a source of edge. The creator does not claim to have measured it, and Mandel has no evidence it exists. The research layer is treated as a forecaster with an unknown skill score until scored.
The 1.7% survivors. Rejected as evidence of edge until a hold-out test and the correction method are shown; accepted as evidence that the tested methodology mostly does not work.
"Deterministic equals safe." Determinism buys reproducibility and auditability, not validity. A deterministic rule found by searching 258M configurations is the canonical overfitting hazard.

Win rate as a headline metric. A 52% win rate says nothing without payoff asymmetry, costs and trade count; Mandel ranks on proper scores and deflated risk-adjusted return, never on hit rate. The PickMyTrade thresholds (45% win rate and 1.0R for trend systems, 55% for mean reversion) are genre folklore, not derived quantities.

Post-hoc repairs reported as results. "After adding a 50-EMA filter the Q1 return moved from −5.3% to +3.1%" is a second trial on the same sample; Mandel counts it in n_trials and does not count it as evidence.
The "no code" framing and the sales funnel. Reviews note that "no code" understates the setup work; Mandel ignores the packaging and keeps the engineering pattern.

Voice-dictated prompts and model-vendor rankings. [bg-other] Blackwood's claim that dictated prompts are 2–3x longer and better, and Angus Li's per-task model table, are unmeasured preferences tied to products they promote; Mandel notes the idea (longer, more specific specs) and discards the specifics.

Any specific claim about this video's spoken content beyond the chapter titles. Coverage is 0.40; if the transcript becomes available, re-read this file against it and amend the [sibling]-tagged bullets first.

Component registry. Each registered component carries kind ∈ {deterministic, stochastic}, inputs, outputs, evaluation_method ∈ {backtest, forecast_scoring, tests}, cost_per_call, code_hash (deterministic) or prompt_hash + model_id + temperature + seed (stochastic). Gate rule: evidence.kind must match component.evaluation_method; a backtest attached to a stochastic component is a hard reject with reason evidence_kind_mismatch.

Model-call log. Append-only llm_calls.jsonl: {ts, component, role, model_id, prompt_hash, input_hash, temperature, seed, raw_output, tokens_in, tokens_out, usd}. Replay protocol: run the same frozen input k=5 times; agreement_rate = share of runs producing the same decision-relevant field; a stochastic component with agreement_rate below a registered threshold cannot be promoted to any role that feeds an alert or a trade. role ∈ {hypothesize, specify, implement, evaluate, review} with a per-role default temperature table in versioned config.

Daily cycle shape. ingest (deterministic) → features and alerts (deterministic predicates from versioned config) → one interpretation pass (stochastic, budgeted) → ledger and dashboard → human. The interpretation pass has a hard token and dollar cap per cycle; exceeding it is logged as a cycle failure, not silently retried.

Spec interrogation before pre-registration. ProposalBook.draft() for any strategy or code_change proposal requires a filled spec = {data_source, available_at_rule, timeframe, entry_rule, exit_rule, edge_cases[], cost_model, regimes_covered[]}; preregister() refuses a draft with any null spec field and records the refusal reason. The question set is a versioned file so it can itself be improved through the gate.

Parameter-sweep protocol. sweep = {dials, grid_size, n_trials_preregistered, sampler_seed, cost_model, splits}; walk_forward_splits with embargo; deflated_sharpe_ratio computed with the pre-registered n_trials (not the number of configurations that happened to finish, and incremented by every post-hoc repair); report {n_survivors, expected_false_positives = n_trials × alpha, best_dsr}; verdict no_edge_found when n_survivors ≤ expected_false_positives or best_dsr < 0.95. Register the sweep's result as a negative insight when it fails.

Cost-model schema and friction stress. {fee_taker, fee_maker, spread_or_slippage, fill_probability, latency_ms} required on every backtest record; null in any field fails code_change_criteria for strategy proposals. compare_strategies is run twice, at 1x and 2x the registered friction; the strategy_improvement_criteria verdict is taken from the 2x run.

Regime coverage field. Every backtest record carries regime_table = {regime_label: {n_trades, sharpe, max_dd}} using Mandel's regime labels (volatility and trend buckets, or the MarkovBaseline states from file 11); eligibility requires n_trades ≥ min_n in at least three regimes and the same sign of edge in a majority of them (ties to ORIGINAL-IDEAS #3, scale-consistent edge).

Simplicity constraints. Store n_free_params per configuration; enforce n_trades / n_free_params ≥ T (T registered, start at 30) for eligibility; favour frequent-signal rules because they reach the min_n in forecast_improvement_criteria sooner.

Claim-testing queue. Claims from gurus, children or papers enter as {claim, claimed_metric, source}; a standing proposal type converts a claim into dials and a sweep; the recorded output is {claimed_metric, measured_metric, gap}, which is what the children receive instead of the claim. Seed entries: "ICT Silver Bullet wins 70–80%" (measured 52%, source AI Pathways), "VWAP 2σ mean reversion 57% / 2.1R" (live 41% / 1.4R, source PickMyTrade).

Alert config as code. Alert predicates (edge thresholds, exposure limits, stale-data checks) live in a versioned file read by deterministic code; the stochastic layer may *propose* a change to that file, which then goes through the ordinary gate like any code change.

Challenge pass as a registered stochastic component. A second model call with role review that must state what it would change and what evidence supports it; its output is logged and scored by whether its objections predicted gate rejections (review_precision). Because "challenge the first answer" is only worth its tokens if the challenges turn out to be right.

Child onboarding question set. At first contact, each child is asked to list its components with kind and evaluation_method, its cost per cycle, its memory file (CLAUDE.md or equivalent) and the hash of it, and which of its claims have been scored out of sample; unclassified components default to stochastic and unscored.

Metrics added to Mandel's own scoreboard. usd_per_cycle, usd_per_validated_improvement, stochastic_agreement_rate per component, sweeps_run / sweeps_with_edge, claims_tested / claims_confirmed, spec_refusals (drafts bounced for missing spec fields), review_precision.

Regime is a first-class latent variable in the substrate. Because mispricings, spreads, fill rates and news flow on Polymarket and Kalshi cluster in time, and a strategy's edge measured without conditioning on regime is an average over states it may never trade in again. Mandel's regime engine is a component, with its own tests, evaluated before anything consumes it (resource 13's "core logic first").

Filtered-only rule for every model-derived feature. Because predict/predict_proba on a full series is look-ahead by construction. Any feature produced by a fitted model must be computed from data with available_at ≤ decision_ts; smoothed posteriors and Viterbi paths are permitted for diagnostics only and are tagged diagnostic, which the gate refuses as backtest input. This is MANDEL.md principle 9 (point-in-time) made specific.

Freeze and version every fit; store emitted labels, not recomputed ones. Because refitting shifts old labels even with filtered decoding. A fit is {fit_id, train_window, θ, random_states, bic, code_hash}; the regime series Mandel backtests on is the concatenation of what each frozen fit emitted at the time.

Pre-register the refit cadence and the state count, and account for both as trials. Because the number of states, the label threshold, the lookback and the refit schedule are all dials, and every dial multiplies the trial count that deflated_sharpe_ratio must be fed.

Multiple restarts and a stability metric. Because Baum–Welch finds local optima; Mandel fits with ≥ 5 seeds, keeps the best likelihood, and records label_stability (fraction of historical argmax labels unchanged after a refit). A model with low stability is not well separated and cannot feed a decision.

Simplest baseline first. Because the genre's own simplest version (a counted 3×3 transition matrix) is a legitimate baseline for the HMM; Mandel promotes a regime model only if it beats both the no-regime strategy and the counted-matrix baseline out of sample.

Regime-conditioned reporting. Because a strategy that works in one regime is a different object from one that works in all; compare_strategies output is extended with per-regime edge and per-regime Brier, and a strategy whose edge lives in one state gets a regime gate rather than a promotion.

Regimes are hazards, not timers. Because the HMM quantifies the probability of being in a state and of leaving it, and lags true changes; Mandel uses regime posteriors to scale exposure and thresholds, never as an entry signal on its own. Expected duration 1/(1−A[k,k]) must exceed the strategy's holding period plus the refit cadence, or the regime is not actionable after costs.

"Named-institution technique" is a claim-import class. Because "hedge funds use this" is the most common way a method enters a retail workflow; Mandel records it as {claim, institution, technique, claimed_metric} with no insight weight until the technique has a measured out-of-sample result on Mandel's own data.

Model as implementer, human and tests as specifiers. Because the video's working pattern, and resource 12's, is that Claude writes the code to a specification the human understands; Mandel's children are asked for the specification (states, features, decode mode, refit cadence, cost model, split) before the code, and the specification is what gets reviewed.
"Profitable trading strategies." No number, no out-of-sample period, no costs recovered. Recorded as an anecdote with zero insight weight.

"Copying top hedge funds." The HMM is not Renaissance's edge; it is a 1960s algorithm its own inventor stopped trading with. The framing imports prestige, not evidence. Mandel keeps the technique and drops the association.

Hand-labelled three-state regimes (bull/bear/sideways by a ±2% or ±5% 20-day return threshold). The threshold and window are free parameters chosen by inspection; the labels are then "fit" by counting, which looks parameter-free and is not. If Mandel uses such labels, the threshold grid is counted as trials.
Regime output as a direct trading signal. sign(P(bull) − P(bear)) on daily data with no costs is the genre's default and is, on the evidence available, untested; the HMM's honest use is conditioning.

Stationarity of regimes. "Fitted regimes are not guaranteed to persist out of sample." A regime model trained on 2020–2024 prediction-market microstructure may not describe 2026's; Mandel treats regime definitions as versioned and re-validated, not discovered once.

Claude Code as evidence. That an agent can write a correct GaussianHMM pipeline in twenty minutes says nothing about whether the pipeline has edge; the implementation layer's quality is tested with unit tests, the strategy's quality with held-out data, and the two are not interchangeable.

The research hint's workflow as the video's content. CLAUDE.md conventions, tests, walk-forward and paper trading are good practice and Mandel adopts them, but they are not confirmed to be in this video. The protocol below is Mandel's, grown from the chapter structure.

Any specific claim about this video's spoken content beyond the chapters and three snippet sentences. Coverage is 0.35; if a transcript becomes available, re-read the [snippet], [genre] and [mine] bullets first.

RegimeModel registry entry (extends the component registry from resource 12): {component: "regime_hmm", kind: "deterministic", evaluation_method: "backtest", features: [...], n_states: K, covariance_type, n_iter, restarts: [seeds], decode: "filtered", refit_cadence: "weekly|monthly", train_window: "expanding|rolling:N", code_hash}. kind is deterministic only because seeds are fixed and recorded; a fit without recorded seeds is unscored. decode must be filtered; smoothed or viterbi fits are accepted with evaluation_method: "diagnostic" and refused by the gate as backtest evidence.

Bitemporal regime store. regime_states.jsonl: {ts, fit_id, probs: [p_1..p_K], argmax, valid_at, available_at}, where available_at is the wall-clock moment the fit that emitted the row could have existed (end of its training window plus compute time). Backtests join on available_at ≤ decision_ts. Test: test_regime_features_are_filtered asserts that recomputing any stored row from data truncated at its available_at reproduces it; a mismatch is a hard reject with reason smoothed_feature_leak. This is ORIGINAL-IDEAS §1 (bitemporal substrate) given its first concrete consumer.

Fit registry. fits.jsonl: {fit_id, component, train_start, train_end, θ_hash, log_likelihood, bic, seeds_tried, best_seed, label_stability_vs_prev, created_at}. label_stability_vs_prev = share of the previous fit's in-sample argmax labels unchanged under the new fit; registered minimum (start at 0.90) below which the fit is logged and not promoted.

Walk-forward refit protocol. Use walk_forward_splits with an embargo at least as long as the strategy's holding period; at each split, fit on the training fold with the registered restarts, emit filtered probabilities over the test fold using only the frozen fit, append to the regime store, never backfill. Refit cadence, K, threshold grid and feature set are pre-registered in the proposal, and their product is n_trials for deflated_sharpe_ratio / expected_max_sharpe.

State-count selection rule. Fit K ∈ {2,3,4} on the training fold only; choose by BIC and by label_stability across two adjacent refits; record all three fits. K chosen by test-fold performance is a forking path and fails strategy_improvement_criteria.

Per-regime metrics in compare_strategies. Add by_regime: {k: {n, edge, sharpe, brier, max_dd}} and a regime_dependence flag when the all-sample edge is explained by one state. A regime-dependent strategy is promotable only with an attached regime gate (trade only when P(s_t=k) ≥ τ, τ pre-registered), and the gated strategy is what gets backtested.

Actionability check. For each state, expected_duration_k = 1 / (1 − A[k,k]) (in bars). Gate rule: min_k expected_duration_k ≥ holding_period + refit_cadence; otherwise the regime cannot be acted on before it changes, and the proposal is returned with reason regime_too_fast_for_costs.

Prediction-market feature set for the regime engine (what Mandel's HMM observes, since it does not trade equity returns): daily log-change of the implied probability, realised volatility of the implied probability, bid–ask spread, volume, time-to-resolution bucket, and a news-intensity count; standardised; fit per market category. Hypothesis to pre-register: cross-platform spreads (Polymarket vs Kalshi) widen in the high-volatility state and arbitrage fill rates fall; if true, the bot's size and threshold become regime-conditional.

Baselines ladder. Every regime proposal is compared against three baselines on the same splits: no regime; counted transition matrix on a hand-labelled series (the genre's simplest version); and a rolling-volatility threshold (a one-feature regime). Promotion requires beating all three on the deflated metric; the result, pass or fail, is stored as an insight with provenance src:13.

Claude Code protocol for children building a model component (Mandel's protocolisation of chapters 2–5; not attributed to the video): (i) *Specify*: states, features, decode mode, refit cadence, cost model, split, baselines, n_trials, in a pre-registered proposal. (ii) *Core logic*: implement the component alone with unit tests, including a synthetic-data test where true states are known and recovered-state accuracy is asserted, and a leak test (step 2). (iii) *Agent implements*: Claude Code writes the pipeline against the spec; the review checks the spec, not the prose. (iv) *Validate*: walk-forward, costs, deflated Sharpe against baselines. (v) *Adjust*: integrate as conditioning only. (vi) *Paper*: the regime series is emitted live and stored before any live-money change (MANDEL.md principle 13). Repository conventions (CLAUDE.md or equivalent) state the filtered-only rule, the cost-model schema and the refit protocol so that the agent cannot "helpfully" call predict_proba on the full series.
Metrics added to Mandel's scoreboard. regime_fits / regime_fits_stable, regime_proposals / regime_proposals_beating_baselines, smoothed_feature_leaks_caught, and per-component label_stability.

Negative-result memory. If the HMM fails to beat the counted matrix or the volatility threshold on Mandel's markets, that is recorded as a validated negative insight ("regime model X adds nothing over Y on data Z, splits S"), and the children receive the negative result instead of the technique.

LLM as researcher and monitor, never as the live decision-maker. Because the only parts of the pipeline that are auditable, testable and switch-off-able are the deterministic strategy and the executor; the agent's value is in the search and the watching (same conclusion as resource 12).

Cost-inclusive evaluation as a hard requirement of the gate. Because net edge = e − c and c scales with trade count; a candidate evaluated at zero fees and mid-price fills has not been evaluated. Mandel already carries venue fees in config.yaml (taker_fee_bps: 150, maker_fee_bps: 0, slippage_tolerance: 0.02); the gate must refuse evidence that was not produced with them.
Profit factor, max drawdown, trade count and a naive benchmark as the reported quartet, not win rate. Because win rate is trivially gamed by stop/target geometry and PF already encodes p, W and L.

Incubation as a gate stage that cannot be contaminated by selection. Because it is the one out-of-sample test that best-of-N search over history cannot reach: the data did not exist when the candidate was chosen. Mandel's principle 13 (no live-money change without the gate and the user) already requires dry-run; this makes the dry-run window a measured, pre-registered stage with its own pass criteria.

"Expected range" monitoring with a pre-registered kill switch. Because the follow-up's "losing streak vs edge decay" is the correct question and it is answerable: derive the distribution of drawdowns, streaks and rolling PF from the accepted candidate's own backtest, and demote or disable when live falls outside it.

Selection-aware acceptance: every search declares its trial count. Because 1,368 → 277 is noise unless deflated. Mandel's Proposal.n_trials_declared and deflated_sharpe_ratio(n_trials=...) exist for this; the lesson is that the count must include every variant the agent tried, including ones it discarded before reporting.

No signal may read information that was not available at decision time (the multi-timeframe rule, generalised). Because repainting is look-ahead, and in Mandel's domain the analogues are using a later order-book snapshot, a resolved outcome, or a cross-venue quote that arrived after the decision timestamp.

Risk limits enforced in the executor, not in the alerting or signal layer. Because stops that live in TradingView fail during wicks; limits that live in a notification pipeline fail when the pipeline lags. Mandel's position caps (max_position_per_market, max_order_size) must be checked at order placement, not upstream.
Capped, isolated capital per strategy. Because "if the AI does something unexpected, the damage is capped at that number" is the correct design for anything new, and Mandel's children are new.
Diversification measured as correlation, not counted as bots. Because "non-correlated" is a matrix property; seven bots on one factor are one bot.

A public ledger of every live decision. Because the one thing the creator does that improves on his genre is to promise profits, losses, drawdowns and open trades in public; Mandel's append-only ledger.jsonl is that scoreboard, and it must include losses.

Research from the commons first. Because converting an existing, documented indicator or published rule into a testable candidate is cheaper and more honest than inventing one; Mandel's adjacent-resource and children pipelines are its version of "paste the open-source script into Claude".

Reject the profitability claims as evidence of anything. "+102.5%" is one month of one self-reported account from a vendor whose site has advertised four- and five-digit percentage returns; no fee-inclusive statement, drawdown or trade log was recovered. Mandel records the number as a claim with provenance "vendor, unverified", never as a prior.

Reject pass counts as evidence. "277 of 1,368 passed" is the expected output of running 1,368 noisy tests against a threshold on a trending market; without the trial-level distribution it says nothing about the 277.

Hold loosely: "volatility is forecastable, direction isn't." True as a rule of thumb (volatility clusters; returns are close to unpredictable), and it motivates regime filters that Mandel's HMM work (resource 13) also uses. But a volatility filter that doubled the in-sample PF and halved the trade count was *chosen because it did that*, which is one more trial in the count.

Hold loosely: the NNFX template as a strategy prior. It is a sane template for trend-following on continuous price series. Prediction-market contracts are bounded, resolve to 0/1, and are priced as probabilities; moving-average trend logic transfers poorly. What transfers is the *structure*: one direction signal, independent confirmations, a filter for the regime in which the signal is known to fail, and exits defined before entry.

Hold loosely: "incubate for one to three months." The right incubation length is a trade-count and confidence-interval question, not a calendar one; for a strategy with a handful of trades per week, three months is still too few trades to separate PF 1.3 from PF 1.0.

Reject the single-timeframe rule as stated; keep its reason. Multi-timeframe logic is fine if every input is lagged to what was knowable at the decision bar. The rule exists because most implementations are not, and because it is hard to audit; Mandel adopts the audit, not the ban.

Reject the "no coding required" framing for Mandel's own work. The video's audience is retail; Mandel's learning lives in versioned code and evaluation harnesses, and a candidate whose code Mandel cannot read is the black box the creator says nearly wiped him out.

Reject LLM-run live scalping entirely (the sibling's 4-for-4 experiment), including as a demo: tiny sample, 9× leverage, and the creator himself says the AI's trading instincts are the losing crowd's.
Hold the "AI Trading Arena" and LLM-vs-LLM leaderboards at arm's length. They are entertainment, not evaluation: no shared costs, no shared risk limits, short windows, survivorship of the loud.

Cost-inclusive evidence is mandatory. Extend gate.strategy_improvement_criteria() and evidence_from_comparison() so evidence carries costs_included == 1.0, fee_model_id (hash of the venue fee/slippage parameters used) and fill_model ("mid" is rejected; "book_depth" or "conservative_touch" accepted). A comparison whose returns were computed at mid-price or zero fee fails the gate before any statistic is read. Slippage for the arb bot is depth-weighted: fill_price = Σ_k p_k·q_k / Σ_k q_k over the book levels needed to fill q, not the best quote.

Report the quartet. Every backtest record stores pf_net, max_drawdown, n_trades, benchmark_return (for the arb bot: holding the market price to resolution, or doing nothing) alongside Sharpe.
